      "rawContent": "---\nname: neon-js\ndescription: Sets up the full Neon JS SDK with unified auth and PostgREST-style database queries. Configures auth client, data client, and type generation. Use when building apps that need both authentication and database access in one SDK.\nallowed-tools: [\"bash\", \"write\", \"read_file\"]\n---\n\n# Neon JS SDK Integration\n\nSet up the unified Neon JS SDK for authentication and database queries in one package.\n\n## When to Use This Skill\n\n- Building apps that need both auth and database queries\n- Migrating from Supabase to Neon\n- Using PostgREST-style API for database access\n- Need type-safe database queries with generated types\n\n**Package**: `@neondatabase/neon-js` (full SDK with auth + data API)\n\n**Need auth only?** Use the `neon-auth` skill instead for `@neondatabase/auth` with a smaller bundle.\n\n## Code Generation Rules\n\nWhen generating TypeScript/JavaScript code, follow these rules:\n\n**Complete reference:** See [Code Generation Rules](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/neondatabase-labs/ai-rules/main/references/code-generation-rules.md) for:\n- Import path handling (path aliases vs relative imports)\n- Neon package imports (subpath exports, adapter patterns)\n- CSS import strategy (Tailwind detection, single import method)\n- File structure patterns\n\n**Key points:**\n- Check `tsconfig.json` for path aliases before generating imports\n- Use relative imports if unsure or no aliases exist\n- `BetterAuthReactAdapter` MUST be imported from `auth/react/adapters` subpath\n- Adapters are factory functions - call them with `()`\n- Choose ONE CSS import method (Tailwind or CSS, not both)\n\n## Available Guides\n\nEach guide is a complete, self-contained walkthrough with numbered phases:\n\n- **`guides/setup.md`** - Complete setup guide for Next.js with auth + data API\n\nI'll automatically detect your context (package manager, framework, existing setup) and select the appropriate guide based on your request.\n\nFor troubleshooting, see the [Troubleshooting Guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/neondatabase-labs/ai-rules/main/references/neon-auth-troubleshooting.md) in references.\n\n## Quick Examples\n\nTell me what you're building - I'll handle the rest:\n\n- \"Set up Neon JS for my Next.js app\" -> Loads full stack guide, configures auth + data\n- \"Add database queries to my auth setup\" -> Configures data API client\n- \"Migrate from Supabase\" -> Uses SupabaseAuthAdapter for compatibility\n\n## Reference Documentation\n\n**Primary Resource:** See [neon-js.mdc](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/neondatabase-labs/ai-rules/main/neon-js.mdc) for comprehensive guidelines including:\n- Client setup for all frameworks\n- Database query patterns (PostgREST syntax)\n- Auth adapter options (BetterAuth, Supabase)\n- Type generation\n- Error handling\n\n**Auth Details:** See [neon-auth.mdc](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/neondatabase-labs/ai-rules/main/neon-auth.mdc) for:\n- All authentication methods\n- UI components\n- Session management\n\n**Framework-Specific Setup (choose your framework):**\n- [Setup - Adapter comparison\n- [Import Reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/neondatabase-labs/ai-rules/main/references/neon-js-imports.md) - Complete import paths\n\n## Templates\n\n- `templates/full-client.ts` - Unified auth + data client configuration\n\n## Related Skills\n\n- **neon-auth** - Auth only (smaller bundle, no data queries)\n- **neon-drizzle** - Drizzle ORM setup (alternative to PostgREST)\n- **neon-serverless** -       "contentPreview": "---\nname: neon-serverless\ndescription: Configures Neon Serverless Driver for Next.js, Vercel Edge Functions, AWS Lambda, and other serverless environments. Installs @neondatabase/serverless, sets up environment variables, and creates working API route examples with TypeScript types. Use when users n",
      "rawContent": "---\nname: neon-serverless\ndescription: Configures Neon Serverless Driver for Next.js, Vercel Edge Functions, AWS Lambda, and other serverless environments. Installs @neondatabase/serverless, sets up environment variables, and creates working API route examples with TypeScript types. Use when users need to connect their application to Neon, fetch or query data from a Neon database, integrate Neon with Next.js or serverless frameworks, or set up database access in edge/serverless environments where traditional PostgreSQL clients don't work.\nallowed-tools: [\"bash\"]\n---\n\n# Neon Serverless Skill\n\nConfigures the Neon Serverless Driver for optimal performance in serverless and edge computing environments.\n\n## When to Use\n\n- Setting up connections for edge functions (Vercel Edge, Cloudflare Workers)\n- Configuring serverless APIs (AWS Lambda, Google Cloud Functions)\n- Optimizing for low-latency database access\n- Implementing connection pooling for high-throughput apps\n\n**Not recommended for:** Complex multi-statement transactions (use WebSocket Pool), persistent servers (use native PostgreSQL drivers), or offline-first applications.\n\n## Code Generation Rules\n\nWhen generating TypeScript/JavaScript code:\n- BEFORE generating import statements, check tsconfig.json for path aliases (compilerOptions.paths)\n- If path aliases exist (e.g., \"@/*\": [\"./src/*\"]), use them (e.g., import { x } from '@/lib/utils')\n- If NO path aliases exist or unsure, ALWAYS use relative imports (e.g., import { x } from '../../../lib/utils')\n- Verify imports match the project's configuration\n- Default to relative imports - they always work regardless of configuration\n\n## Reference Documentation\n\n**Primary Resource:** See `[neon-serverless.mdc](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/neondatabase-labs/ai-rules/main/neon-serverless.mdc)` in project root for comprehensive guidelines including:\n- Installation and compatibility requirements\n- HTTP vs WebSocket adapter selection\n- Connection pooling strategies\n- Query optimization patterns\n- Error handling and troubleshooting\n\n## Quick Setup\n\n### Installation\n```bash\nnpm install @neondatabase/serverless\n```\n\n### Connection Patterns\n\n**HTTP Client** (recommended for edge/serverless):\n```typescript\nimport { neon } from '@neondatabase/serverless';\nconst sql = neon(process.env.DATABASE_URL!);\nconst rows = await sql`SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ${userId}`;\n```\n\n**WebSocket Pool** (for Node.js long-lived connections):\n```typescript\nimport { Pool } from '@neondatabase/serverless';\nconst pool = new Pool({ connectionString: process.env.DATABASE_URL! });\nconst result = await pool.query('SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = $1', [userId]);\n```\n\nSee `templates/` for complete examples:\n- `templates/http-connection.ts` - HTTP client setup\n- `templates/websocket-pool.ts` - WebSocket pool configuration\n\n## Validation\n\nUse `scripts/validate-connection.ts` to test your database connection before deployment.\n\n## Related Skills\n\n- **neon-auth** - Add authentication\n- **neon-js** - Full SDK with auth + data API\n- **neon-drizzle** - For ORM with serverless connections\n- **neon-toolkit** - For ephemeral database testing\n\n---\n\n**Want best practices in your project?** Run `neon-plugin:add-neon-docs` with parameter `SKILL_NAME=\"neon-serverless\"` to add reference links.\n",
      "renderedContent": "<hr>\n<h2>name: neon-serverless\ndescription: Configures Neon Serverless Driver for Next.js, Vercel Edge Functions, AWS Lambda, and other serverless environments. Installs @neondatabase/serverless, sets up environment variables, and creates working API route examples with TypeScript types. Use when users need to connect their application to Neon, fetch or query data from a Neon database, integrate Neon with Next.js or serverless frameworks, or set up database access in edge/serverless environments where traditional PostgreSQL clients don&#39;t work.\nallowed-tools: [&quot;bash&quot;]<\/h2>\n<h1>Neon Serverless Skill<\/h1>\n<p>Configures the Neon Serverless Driver for optimal performance in serverless and edge computing environments.<\/p>\n<h2>When to Use<\/h2>\n<ul>\n<li>Setting up connections for edge functions (Vercel Edge, Cloudflare Workers)<\/li>\n<li>Configuring serverless APIs (AWS Lambda, Google Cloud Functions)<\/li>\n<li>Optimizing for low-latency database access<\/li>\n<li>Implementing connection pooling for high-throughput apps<\/li>\n<\/ul>\n<p><strong>Not recommended for:<\/strong> Complex multi-statement transactions (use WebSocket Pool), persistent servers (use native PostgreSQL drivers), or offline-first applications.<\/p>\n<h2>Code Generation Rules<\/h2>\n<p>When generating TypeScript/JavaScript code:<\/p>\n<ul>\n<li>BEFORE generating import statements, check tsconfig.json for path aliases (compilerOptions.paths)<\/li>\n<li>If path aliases exist (e.g., &quot;@/<em>&quot;: [&quot;./src/<\/em>&quot;]), use them (e.g., import { x } from &#39;@/lib/utils&#39;)<\/li>\n<li>If NO path aliases exist or unsure, ALWAYS use relative imports (e.g., import { x } from &#39;../../../lib/utils&#39;)<\/li>\n<li>Verify imports match the project&#39;s configuration<\/li>\n<li>Default to relative imports - they always work regardless of configuration<\/li>\n<\/ul>\n<h2>Reference Documentation<\/h2>\n<p><strong>Primary Resource:<\/strong> See <code>[neon-serverless.mdc](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/neondatabase-labs/ai-rules/main/neon-serverless.mdc)<\/code> in project root for comprehensive guidelines including:<\/p>\n<ul>\n<li>Installation and compatibility requirements<\/li>\n<li>HTTP vs WebSocket adapter selection<\/li>\n<li>Connection pooling strategies<\/li>\n<li>Query optimization patterns<\/li>\n<li>Error handling and troubleshooting<\/li>\n<\/ul>\n<h2>Quick Setup<\/h2>\n<h3>Installation<\/h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-bash\">npm install @neondatabase/serverless\n<\/code><\/pre>\n<h3>Connection Patterns<\/h3>\n<p><strong>HTTP Client<\/strong> (recommended for edge/serverless):<\/p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-typescript\">import { neon } from &#39;@neondatabase/serverless&#39;;\nconst sql = neon(process.env.DATABASE_URL!);\nconst rows = await sql`SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ${userId}`;\n<\/code><\/pre>\n<p><strong>WebSocket Pool<\/strong> (for Node.js long-lived connections):<\/p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-typescript\">import { Pool } from &#39;@neondatabase/serverless&#39;;\nconst pool = new Pool({ connectionString: process.env.DATABASE_URL! });\nconst result = await pool.query(&#39;SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = $1&#39;, [userId]);\n<\/code><\/pre>\n<p>See <code>templates/<\/code> for complete examples:<\/p>\n<ul>\n<li><code>templates/http-connection.ts<\/code> - HTTP client setup<\/li>\n<li><code>templates/websocket-pool.ts<\/code> - WebSocket pool configuration<\/li>\n<\/ul>\n<h2>Validation<\/h2>\n<p>Use <code>scripts/validate-connection.ts<\/code> to test your database connection before deployment.<\/p>\n<h2>Related Skills<\/h2>\n<ul>\n<li><strong>neon-auth<\/strong> - Add authentication<\/li>\n<li><strong>neon-js<\/strong> - Full SDK with auth + data API<\/li>\n<li><strong>neon-drizzle<\/strong> - For ORM with serverless connections<\/li>\n<li><strong>neon-toolkit<\/strong> - For ephemeral database testing<\/li>\n<\/ul>\n<hr>\n<p><strong>Want best practices in your project?<\/strong> Run <code>neon-plugin:add-neon-docs<\/code> with parameter <code>SKILL_NAME=&quot;neon-serverless&quot;<\/code> to add reference links.<\/p>\n"

      "contentPreview": "---\nname: neon-toolkit\ndescription: Creates and manages ephemeral Neon databases for testing, CI/CD pipelines, and isolated development environments. Use when building temporary databases for automated tests or rapid prototyping.\nallowed-tools: [\"bash\"]\n---\nAutomates creation, management, and cleanu",
      "rawContent": "---\nname: neon-toolkit\ndescription: Creates and manages ephemeral Neon databases for testing, CI/CD pipelines, and isolated development environments. Use when building temporary databases for automated tests or rapid prototyping.\nallowed-tools: [\"bash\"]\n---\n\n# Neon Toolkit Skill\n\nAutomates creation, management, and cleanup of temporary Neon databases using the Neon Toolkit.\n\n## When to Use\n\n- Creating fresh databases for each test run\n- Spinning up databases in CI/CD pipelines\n- Building isolated development environments\n- Rapid prototyping without manual setup\n\n**Not recommended for:** Production databases, shared team environments, local-only development (use Docker), or free tier accounts (requires paid projects).\n\n## Code Generation Rules\n\nWhen generating TypeScript/JavaScript code:\n- BEFORE generating import statements, check tsconfig.json for path aliases (compilerOptions.paths)\n- If path aliases exist (e.g., \"@/*\": [\"./src/*\"]), use them (e.g., import { x } from '@/lib/utils')\n- If NO path aliases exist or unsure, ALWAYS use relative imports (e.g., import { x } from '../../../lib/utils')\n- Verify imports match the project's configuration\n- Default to relative imports - they always work regardless of configuration\n\n## Reference Documentation\n\n**Primary Resource:** See `[neon-toolkit.mdc](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/neondatabase-labs/ai-rules/main/neon-toolkit.mdc)` in project root for comprehensive guidelines including:\n- Core concepts (Organization, Project, Branch, Endpoint)\n- Installation and authentication setup\n- Database lifecycle management patterns\n- API client usage examples\n- Error handling strategies\n\n## Quick Setup\n\n### Installation\n```bash\nnpm install @neondatabase/toolkit\n```\n\n### Basic Usage\n```typescript\nimport { NeonToolkit } from '@neondatabase/toolkit';\n\nconst neon = new NeonToolkit({ apiKey: process.env.NEON_API_KEY! });\n\n// Create ephemeral database\nconst db = await neon.createEphemeralDatabase();\nconsole.log(`Database URL: ${db.url}`);\n\n// Use the database...\n\n// Cleanup\nawait db.delete();\n```\n\n## Templates & Scripts\n\n- `templates/toolkit-workflow.ts` - Complete ephemeral database workflow\n- `scripts/create-ephemeral-db.ts` - Create a temporary database\n- `scripts/destroy-ephemeral-db.ts` - Clean up ephemeral database\n\n## Common Use Cases\n\n### Testing\n```typescript\nconst db = await neon.createEphemeralDatabase();\n// Run tests with fresh database\nawait db.delete();\n```\n\n### CI/CD Integration\n```bash\nexport NEON_API_KEY=${{ secrets.NEON_API_KEY }}\nnpm test  # Uses ephemeral database\n```\n\n## Related Skills\n\n- **neon-serverless** - For connecting to databases\n- **neon-drizzle** - For schema and migrations\n\n---\n\n**Want best practices in your project?** Run `neon-plugin:add-neon-docs` with parameter `SKILL_NAME=\"neon-toolkit\"` to add reference links.\n",
      "renderedContent": "<hr>\n<h2>name: neon-toolkit\ndescription: Creates and manages ephemeral Neon databases for testing, CI/CD pipelines, and isolated development environments. Use when building temporary databases for automated tests or rapid prototyping.\nallowed-tools: [&quot;bash&quot;]<\/h2>\n<h1>Neon Toolkit Skill<\/h1>\n<p>Automates creation, management, and cleanup of temporary Neon databases using the Neon Toolkit.<\/p>\n<h2>When to Use<\/h2>\n<ul>\n<li>Creating fresh databases for each test run<\/li>\n<li>Spinning up databases in CI/CD pipelines<\/li>\n<li>Building isolated development environments<\/li>\n<li>Rapid prototyping without manual setup<\/li>\n<\/ul>\n<p><strong>Not recommended for:<\/strong> Production databases, shared team environments, local-only development (use Docker), or free tier accounts (requires paid projects).<\/p>\n<h2>Code Generation Rules<\/h2>\n<p>When generating TypeScript/JavaScript code:<\/p>\n<ul>\n<li>BEFORE generating import statements, check tsconfig.json for path aliases (compilerOptions.paths)<\/li>\n<li>If path aliases exist (e.g., &quot;@/<em>&quot;: [&quot;./src/<\/em>&quot;]), use them (e.g., import { x } from &#39;@/lib/utils&#39;)<\/li>\n<li>If NO path aliases exist or unsure, ALWAYS use relative imports (e.g., import { x } from &#39;../../../lib/utils&#39;)<\/li>\n<li>Verify imports match the project&#39;s configuration<\/li>\n<li>Default to relative imports - they always work regardless of configuration<\/li>\n<\/ul>\n<h2>Reference Documentation<\/h2>\n<p><strong>Primary Resource:<\/strong> See <code>[neon-toolkit.mdc](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/neondatabase-labs/ai-rules/main/neon-toolkit.mdc)<\/code> in project root for comprehensive guidelines including:<\/p>\n<ul>\n<li>Core concepts (Organization, Project, Branch, Endpoint)<\/li>\n<li>Installation and authentication setup<\/li>\n<li>Database lifecycle management patterns<\/li>\n<li>API client usage examples<\/li>\n<li>Error handling strategies<\/li>\n<\/ul>\n<h2>Quick Setup<\/h2>\n<h3>Installation<\/h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-bash\">npm install @neondatabase/toolkit\n<\/code><\/pre>\n<h3>Basic Usage<\/h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-typescript\">import { NeonToolkit } from &#39;@neondatabase/toolkit&#39;;\n\nconst neon = new NeonToolkit({ apiKey: process.env.NEON_API_KEY! });\n\n// Create ephemeral database\nconst db = await neon.createEphemeralDatabase();\nconsole.log(`Database URL: ${db.url}`);\n\n// Use the database...\n\n// Cleanup\nawait db.delete();\n<\/code><\/pre>\n<h2>Templates &amp; Scripts<\/h2>\n<ul>\n<li><code>templates/toolkit-workflow.ts<\/code> - Complete ephemeral database workflow<\/li>\n<li><code>scripts/create-ephemeral-db.ts<\/code> - Create a temporary database<\/li>\n<li><code>scripts/destroy-ephemeral-db.ts<\/code> - Clean up ephemeral database<\/li>\n<\/ul>\n<h2>Common Use Cases<\/h2>\n<h3>Testing<\/h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-typescript\">const db = await neon.createEphemeralDatabase();\n// Run tests with fresh database\nawait db.delete();\n<\/code><\/pre>\n<h3>CI/CD Integration<\/h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-bash\">export NEON_API_KEY=${{ secrets.NEON_API_KEY }}\nnpm test  # Uses ephemeral database\n<\/code><\/pre>\n<h2>Related Skills<\/h2>\n<ul>\n<li><strong>neon-serverless<\/strong> - For connecting to databases<\/li>\n<li><strong>neon-drizzle<\/strong> - For schema and migrations<\/li>\n<\/ul>\n<hr>\n<p><strong>Want best practices in your project?<\/strong> Run <code>neon-plugin:add-neon-docs<\/code> with parameter <code>SKILL_NAME=&quot;neon-toolkit&quot;<\/code> to add reference links.<\/p>\n"

      "contentPreview": "<picture>\n  <source media=\"(prefers-color-scheme: dark)\" srcset=\"https://neon.com/brand/neon-logo-dark-color.svg?new\">\n  <source media=\"(prefers-color-scheme: light)\" srcset=\"https://neon.com/brand/neon-logo-light-color.svg?new\">\n  <img width=\"250px\" alt=\"Neon Logo fallback\" src=\"https://neon.com/br",
      "rawContent": "<picture>\n  <source media=\"(prefers-color-scheme: dark)\" srcset=\"https://neon.com/brand/neon-logo-dark-color.svg?new\">\n  <source media=\"(prefers-color-scheme: light)\" srcset=\"https://neon.com/brand/neon-logo-light-color.svg?new\">\n  <img width=\"250px\" alt=\"Neon Logo fallback\" src=\"https://neon.com/brand/neon-logo-dark-color.svg?new\">\n<\/picture>\n\n> [!IMPORTANT]\n> **This repository has been archived.** The content has moved to [neondatabase/agent-skills](https://github.com/neondatabase/agent-skills).\n>\n> [Agent Skills](https://neon.com/blog/agent-skills-in-2026) are now a specification supported by all major agents and coding editors, providing more capabilities than rule files. We created a new repository following the agent-skills pattern introduced by Vercel.\n>\n> ```bash\n> npx skills add neondatabase/agent-skills\n> ```\n\n# Neon AI Development Toolkit\n\nA comprehensive Claude Code plugin with AI context rules, guided skills, and resource management tools for building with Neon Postgres. Works with Claude Code, Cursor, and other AI-powered development tools.\n\n## What's Inside\n\n### For Claude Code Users\n- **Claude Code Plugin** - The plugin itself, which includes 6 skills and MCP server integration\n- **Claude Code Skills** - Interactive workflows with templates and automation scripts for Neon\n- **MCP Server Integration** - Direct Neon resource management (projects, branches, databases)\n\n### For Cursor & Other AI Tools\n- **Portable .mdc Files** - Standalone context rules that work anywhere\n- **Tool-Agnostic Format** - Use with any AI assistant supporting custom rules\n\n---\n\n## Quick Start\n\n### Claude Code\n\n**1. Add the Neon marketplace:**\n```bash\n/plugin marketplace add neondatabase-labs/ai-rules\n```\n\n**2. Install the plugin:**\n```bash\n/plugin install neon-plugin@neon\n```\n\n**3. Verify installation:**\nAsk Claude Code: \"which skills do you have access to?\"\n\nYou should see the Neon skills listed.\n\n**4. Start using:**\nUse natural language and skills activate automatically:\n```bash\n> Use the neon-drizzle skill to setup Drizzle ORM with Neon\n```\n\n### Cursor\n\n**1. Create rules directory:**\n```bash\nmkdir -p .cursor/rules\n```\n\n**2. Copy desired `.mdc` files:**\n```bash\n# Example: Copy Drizzle and Serverless rules\ncp neon-drizzle.mdc .cursor/rules/\ncp neon-serverless.mdc .cursor/rules/\n```\n\n**3. Start coding:**\nCursor automatically applies these rules when you reference Neon.\n\n### Other AI Tools\n\nCopy `.mdc` files to your AI tool's custom rules directory. The format is tool-agnostic and works with any AI assistant supporting context rules.\n\n---\n\n## Skills Reference\n\n<details>\n<summary><strong>Neon Drizzle<\/strong> - Setup Drizzle ORM with Neon<\/summary>\n\nComplete workflow support for:\n- New project setup\n- Existing project integration\n- Schema-only workflows\n\n**Includes:**\n- Schema generation utilities\n- Migration scripts (`db:generate`, `db:migrate`, `db:push`, `db:studio`)\n- HTTP and WebSocket adapter templates\n- Technical references for adapters, migrations, and query patterns\n\n**Guides:**\n- `guides/new-project.md` - Starting from scratch\n- `guides/existing-project.md` - Adding to existing codebase\n- `guides/schema-only.md` - Schema-first development\n- `guides/troubleshooting.md` - Common issues and solutions\n\n<\/details>\n\n<details>\n<summary><strong>Neon Serverless<\/strong> - Configure serverless database connections<\/summary>\n\nTemplates for:\n- HTTP connections (single-query operations)\n- WebSocket pooling (long-running processes)\n- Connection validation utilities\n\n<\/details>\n\n<details>\n<summary><strong>Neon Toolkit<\/strong> - Manage ephemeral databases<\/summary>\n\nPerfect for testing and CI/CD:\n- Create temporary databases\n- Run tests in isolation\n- Clean up automatically\n\n**Includes:**\n- `create-ephemeral-db.ts` -       "contentPreview": "Rules for generating TypeScript/JavaScript code when working with Neon Auth and Neon JS SDK.\nImport Path Handling\nNeon Package Imports\nCSS Import Strategy\nAdapter Patterns\n---\n**BEFORE generating import statements, check  for path aliases:**\n**Rules:**\n1. **If path aliases exist** (e.g., ), use them",
      "rawContent": "# Code Generation Rules\n\nRules for generating TypeScript/JavaScript code when working with Neon Auth and Neon JS SDK.\n\n## Table of Contents\n\n- [Import Path Handling](#import-path-handling)\n- [Neon Package Imports](#neon-package-imports)\n- [CSS Import Strategy](#css-import-strategy)\n- [Adapter Patterns](#adapter-patterns)\n\n---\n\n## Import Path Handling\n\n**BEFORE generating import statements, check `tsconfig.json` for path aliases:**\n\n```json\n{\n  \"compilerOptions\": {\n    \"paths\": {\n      \"@/*\": [\"./src/*\"]\n    }\n  }\n}\n```\n\n**Rules:**\n1. **If path aliases exist** (e.g., `\"@/*\": [\"./src/*\"]`), use them:\n   ```typescript\n   import { authClient } from \"@/lib/auth/client\";\n   ```\n\n2. **If NO path aliases exist or unsure**, ALWAYS use relative imports:\n   ```typescript\n   import { authClient } from \"../lib/auth/client\";\n   ```\n\n3. **Default to relative imports** - they always work regardless of configuration\n\n**Why:** Path aliases require specific TypeScript configuration. Relative imports work universally.\n\n---\n\n## Neon Package Imports\n\n### Critical: Subpath Exports\n\n**BetterAuthReactAdapter MUST be imported from subpath:**\n\n```typescript\n// ✅ Correct\nimport { BetterAuthReactAdapter } from \"@neondatabase/auth/react/adapters\";\nimport { BetterAuthReactAdapter } from \"@neondatabase/neon-js/auth/react/adapters\";\n\n// ❌ Wrong - will not work\nimport { BetterAuthReactAdapter } from \"@neondatabase/auth\";\nimport { BetterAuthReactAdapter } from \"@neondatabase/neon-js\";\n```\n\n**Why:** The React adapter has React-specific dependencies and is tree-shaken out of the main bundle. Using subpath exports keeps the main bundle smaller for non-React environments.\n\n### Adapter Factory Functions\n\n**All adapters are factory functions** - they must be called with `()`:\n\n```typescript\n// ✅ Correct\nadapter: BetterAuthReactAdapter()\nadapter: SupabaseAuthAdapter()\nadapter: BetterAuthVanillaAdapter()\n\n// ❌ Wrong\nadapter: BetterAuthReactAdapter\nadapter: SupabaseAuthAdapter\n```\n\n**Why:** Adapters are factory functions that return configured adapter instances. They must be invoked.\n\n### Next.js Integration\n\n**Next.js-specific exports are from subpath:**\n\n```typescript\n// ✅ Correct\nimport { authApiHandler, createAuthClient } from \"@neondatabase/auth/next\";\nimport { authApiHandler, createAuthClient } from \"@neondatabase/neon-js/auth/next\";\n\n// ❌ Wrong\nimport { authApiHandler } from \"@neondatabase/auth\";\n```\n\n### UI Components\n\n**UI components are from subpath:**\n\n```typescript\n// ✅ Correct\nimport { NeonAuthUIProvider, AuthView } from \"@neondatabase/auth/react/ui\";\nimport { NeonAuthUIProvider, AuthView } from \"@neondatabase/neon-js/auth/react/ui\";\n\n// ❌ Wrong\nimport { NeonAuthUIProvider } from \"@neondatabase/auth\";\n```\n\n### Server Utilities (Next.js)\n\n**Server utilities are from separate subpath:**\n\n```typescript\n// ✅ Correct\nimport { authViewPaths } from \"@neondatabase/auth/react/ui/server\";\nimport { authViewPaths } from \"@neondatabase/neon-js/auth/react/ui/server\";\n```\n\n---\n\n## CSS Import Strategy\n\n**CRITICAL:** Choose ONE import method. Never import both - it causes ~94KB of duplicate styles.\n\n### Detection Steps\n\n**1. Check for Tailwind CSS:**\n\nLook for:\n- `tailwind.config.js` or `tailwind.config.ts` in project root\n- `@import 'tailwindcss'` or `@tailwind` directives in CSS files\n- `tailwindcss` in `package.json` dependencies\n\n**2. Choose Import Method:**\n\n**If Tailwind CSS v4 detected:**\n\nAdd to CSS file (e.g., `app/globals.css`, `index.css`):\n```css\n@import 'tailwindcss';\n@import '@neondatabase/auth/ui/tailwind';\n/* Or: @import '@neondatabase/neon-js/ui/tailwind'; */\n```\n\n**If NO Tailwind:**\n\nAdd to app entry point (e.g., `app/layout.tsx`, `src/main.tsx`):\n```typescript\nimport \"@neondatabase/auth/ui/css\";\n// Or: import \"@neondatabase/neon-js/ui/css\";\n```\n\n### Common Mistakes\n\n**❌ Wrong - Importing both:**\n```css\n/* Causes ~94KB duplicate styles */\n@import '@neondatabase/auth/ui/css';\n@import '@neondatabase/auth/ui/tailwind';\n```\n\n**✅ Correct - One method:**\n```css\n/* With Tailwind */\n@import 'tailwindcss';\n@import '@neondatabase/auth/ui/tailwind';\n```\n\n```typescript\n// Without Tailwind\nimport \"@neondatabase/auth/ui/css\";\n```\n\n**Why:** The `ui/css` import includes pre-built CSS (~47KB). The `ui/tailwind` import provides Tailwind tokens (~2KB) that generate similar styles. Using both doubles your CSS bundle.\n\n---\n\n## Adapter Patterns\n\n### React SPA Setup\n\n**For `@neondatabase/auth`:**\n```typescript\nimport { createAuthClient } from \"@neondatabase/auth\";\nimport { BetterAuthReactAdapter } from \"@neondatabase/auth/react/adapters\";\n\nexport const authClient = createAuthClient(\n  import.meta.env.VITE_NEON_AUTH_URL,\n  { adapter: BetterAuthReactAdapter() }\n);\n```\n\n**For `@neondatabase/neon-js`:**\n```typescript\nimport { createClient } from \"@neondatabase/neon-js\";\nimport { BetterAuthReactAdapter } from \"@neondatabase/neon-js/auth/react/adapters\";\n\nexport const client = createClient({\n  auth: {\n    adapter: BetterAuthReactAdapter(),\n    url: import.meta.env.VITE_NEON_AUTH_URL,\n  },\n  dataApi: {\n    url: import.meta.env.VITE_NEON_DATA_API_URL,\n  },\n});\n\nexport const authClient = client.auth;\n```\n\n### Next.js Setup\n\n**No adapter needed** - Next.js integration handles it automatically:\n\n```typescript\nimport { createAuthClient } from \"@neondatabase/auth/next\";\n// Or: import { createAuthClient } from \"@neondatabase/neon-js/auth/next\";\n\nexport const authClient = createAuthClient();\n```\n\n### Node.js Backend\n\n**No adapter needed** - vanilla client works directly:\n\n```typescript\nimport { createAuthClient } from \"@neondatabase/auth\";\n\nconst auth = createAuthClient(process.env.NEON_AUTH_URL!);\n```\n\n### Supabase Compatibility\n\n**Use SupabaseAuthAdapter for Supabase-compatible API:**\n\n```typescript\nimport { createClient, SupabaseAuthAdapter } from \"@neondatabase/neon-js\";\n\nconst client = createClient({\n  auth: {\n    adapter: SupabaseAuthAdapter(),\n    url: process.env.NEON_AUTH_URL!,\n  },\n  dataApi: {\n    url: process.env.NEON_DATA_API_URL!,\n  },\n});\n\n// Use Supabase-style methods\nawait client.auth.signInWithPassword({ email, password });\n```\n\n---\n\n## File Structure Patterns\n\n### Next.js App Router\n\n```\napp/\n  api/\n    auth/\n      [...path]/\n        route.ts          # API route handler\n  auth/\n    [path]/\n      page.tsx            # Auth pages (optional)\n  layout.tsx              # Root layout with provider\n  auth-provider.tsx       # Auth provider component\nlib/\n  auth/\n    client.ts             # Auth client export\n```\n\n### React SPA\n\n```\nsrc/\n  lib/\n    auth-client.ts        # Auth client with adapter\n  providers.tsx           # Auth provider component\n  App.tsx                # Routes\n  main.tsx               # Entry point with BrowserRouter\n```\n\n---\n\n## Common Patterns\n\n### \"use client\" Directive\n\n**Required for client components using hooks:**\n\n```typescript\n\"use client\";\n\nimport { authClient } from \"@/lib/auth/client\";\n\nfunction AuthStatus() {\n  const session = authClient.useSession();\n  // ...\n}\n```\n\n**When to use:**\n- Any component using `authClient.useSession()`\n- Any component using UI components (`UserButton`, `SignedIn`, etc.)\n- Any component that needs client-side interactivity\n\n**When NOT to use:**\n- Server components (Next.js)\n- API routes\n- Server actions\n\n### Environment Variable Access\n\n**Next.js:**\n```typescript\n// Server-side\nprocess.env.NEON_AUTH_BASE_URL\n\n// Client-side (must have NEXT_PUBLIC_ prefix)\nprocess.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_NEON_AUTH_URL\n```\n\n**Vite/React SPA:**\n```typescript\n// Must have VITE_ prefix\nimport.meta.env.VITE_NEON_AUTH_URL\n```\n\n**Create React App:**\n```typescript\n// Must have REACT_APP_ prefix\nprocess.env.REACT_APP_NEON_AUTH_URL\n```\n\n---\n\n## Related References\n\n- [Setup Reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/neondatabase-labs/ai-rules/main/references/neon-auth-setup.md) - Complete setup guide\n- [Import Reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/neondatabase-labs/ai-rules/main/references/neon-js-imports.md) - Complete import paths\n- [Common Mistakes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/neondatabase-labs/ai-rules/main/references/neon-auth-common-mistakes.md) - Detailed error solutions\n\n---\n\n**Reference Version**: 1.0.0  \n**Last Updated**: 2025-12-09\n",

      "contentPreview": "Reference guide for common mistakes when using  or .\nImport Mistakes\n  - BetterAuthReactAdapter Subpath Requirement\n  - Adapter Factory Functions\nCSS Import Mistakes\nConfiguration Mistakes\n  - Wrong createAuthClient Signature\n  - Missing Environment Variables\nUsage Mistakes\n  - Missing \"use client\" ",
      "rawContent": "# Neon Auth/JS - Common Mistakes\n\nReference guide for common mistakes when using `@neondatabase/auth` or `@neondatabase/neon-js`.\n\n## Table of Contents\n\n- [Import Mistakes](#import-mistakes)\n  - [BetterAuthReactAdapter Subpath Requirement](#betterauthreactadapter-subpath-requirement)\n  - [Adapter Factory Functions](#adapter-factory-functions)\n- [CSS Import Mistakes](#css-import-mistakes)\n- [Configuration Mistakes](#configuration-mistakes)\n  - [Wrong createAuthClient Signature](#wrong-createauthclient-signature)\n  - [Missing Environment Variables](#missing-environment-variables)\n- [Usage Mistakes](#usage-mistakes)\n  - [Missing \"use client\" Directive](#missing-use-client-directive)\n  - [Wrong API for Adapter](#wrong-api-for-adapter)\n\n---\n\n## Import Mistakes\n\n### BetterAuthReactAdapter Subpath Requirement\n\n`BetterAuthReactAdapter` is **NOT** exported from the main package entry. You must import it from the subpath.\n\n**Wrong:**\n```typescript\n// These will NOT work\nimport { BetterAuthReactAdapter } from \"@neondatabase/neon-js\";\nimport { BetterAuthReactAdapter } from \"@neondatabase/auth\";\n```\n\n**Correct:**\n```typescript\n// For @neondatabase/neon-js\nimport { BetterAuthReactAdapter } from \"@neondatabase/neon-js/auth/react/adapters\";\n\n// For @neondatabase/auth\nimport { BetterAuthReactAdapter } from \"@neondatabase/auth/react/adapters\";\n```\n\n**Why:** The React adapter has React-specific dependencies and is tree-shaken out of the main bundle. Using subpath exports keeps the main bundle smaller for non-React environments.\n\n### Adapter Factory Functions\n\nAll adapters are **factory functions** that must be called with `()`.\n\n**Wrong:**\n```typescript\nconst client = createClient({\n  auth: {\n    adapter: BetterAuthReactAdapter,  // Missing ()\n    url: process.env.NEON_AUTH_URL!,\n  },\n  dataApi: { url: process.env.NEON_DATA_API_URL! },\n});\n```\n\n**Correct:**\n```typescript\nconst client = createClient({\n  auth: {\n    adapter: BetterAuthReactAdapter(),  // Called as function\n    url: process.env.NEON_AUTH_URL!,\n  },\n  dataApi: { url: process.env.NEON_DATA_API_URL! },\n});\n```\n\nThis applies to all adapters:\n- `BetterAuthReactAdapter()`\n- `BetterAuthVanillaAdapter()`\n- `SupabaseAuthAdapter()`\n\n---\n\n## CSS Import Mistakes\n\nAuth UI components require CSS. Choose **ONE** method based on your project.\n\n### With Tailwind v4\n\n```css\n/* In app/globals.css */\n@import 'tailwindcss';\n@import '@neondatabase/neon-js/ui/tailwind';\n/* Or: @import '@neondatabase/auth/ui/tailwind'; */\n```\n\n### Without Tailwind\n\n```typescript\n// In app/layout.tsx\nimport \"@neondatabase/neon-js/ui/css\";\n// Or: import \"@neondatabase/auth/ui/css\";\n```\n\n### Never Import Both\n\n**Wrong:**\n```css\n/* Causes ~94KB of duplicate styles */\n@import '@neondatabase/neon-js/ui/css';\n@import '@neondatabase/neon-js/ui/tailwind';\n```\n\n**Why:** The `ui/css` import includes pre-built CSS (~47KB). The `ui/tailwind` import provides Tailwind tokens (~2KB) that generate similar styles. Using both doubles your CSS bundle.\n\n---\n\n## Configuration Mistakes\n\n### Wrong createAuthClient Signature\n\nThe `createAuthClient` function takes the URL as the first argument, not as a property in an options object.\n\n**Wrong:**\n```typescript\n// This will NOT work\ncreateAuthClient({ baseURL: url });\ncreateAuthClient({ url: myUrl });\n```\n\n**Correct:**\n```typescript\n// Vanilla client - URL as first arg\ncreateAuthClient(url);\n\n// With adapter - URL as first arg, options as second\ncreateAuthClient(url, { adapter: BetterAuthReactAdapter() });\n\n// Next.js client - no arguments (uses env vars automatically)\nimport { createAuthClient } from \"@neondatabase/auth/next\";\nconst authClient = createAuthClient();\n```\n\n### Missing Environment Variables\n\n**Required for Next.js:**\n```bash\n# .env.local\nNEON_AUTH_BASE_URL=https://ep-xxx.neonauth.c-2.us-east-2.aws.neon.build/dbname/auth\nNEXT_PUBLIC_NEON_AUTH_URL=https://ep-xxx.neonauth.c-2.us-east-2.aws.neon.build/dbname/auth\n\n# For neon-js (auth + data)\nNEON_DATA_API_URL=https://ep-xxx.apirest.c-2.us-east-2.aws.neon.build/dbname/rest/v1\n```\n\n**Required for Vite/React SPA:**\n```bash\n# .env\nVITE_NEON_AUTH_URL=https://ep-xxx.neonauth.c-2.us-east-2.aws.neon.build/dbname/auth\nVITE_NEON_DATA_API_URL=https://ep-xxx.apirest.c-2.us-east-2.aws.neon.build/dbname/rest/v1\n```\n\n**Important:**\n- `NEON_AUTH_BASE_URL` - Server-side auth\n- `NEXT_PUBLIC_*` prefix - Required for client-side access in Next.js\n- `VITE_*` prefix - Required for client-side access in Vite\n- Restart dev server after adding env vars\n\n---\n\n## Usage Mistakes\n\n### Missing \"use client\" Directive\n\nClient components using `useSession()` need the `\"use client\"` directive.\n\n**Wrong:**\n```typescript\n// Missing directive - will cause hydration errors\nimport { authClient } from \"@/lib/auth/client\";\n\nfunction AuthStatus() {\n  const session = authClient.useSession();\n  // ...\n}\n```\n\n**Correct:**\n```typescript\n\"use client\";\n\nimport { authClient } from \"@/lib/auth/client\";\n\nfunction AuthStatus() {\n  const session = authClient.useSession();\n  // ...\n}\n```\n\n### Wrong API for Adapter\n\nEach adapter has its own API style. Don't mix them.\n\n**Wrong - BetterAuth API with SupabaseAuthAdapter:**\n```typescript\nconst client = createClient({\n  auth: { adapter: SupabaseAuthAdapter(), url },\n  dataApi: { url },\n});\n\n// This won't work with SupabaseAuthAdapter\nawait client.auth.signIn.email({ email, password });\n```\n\n**Correct - Supabase API with SupabaseAuthAdapter:**\n```typescript\nconst client = createClient({\n  auth: { adapter: SupabaseAuthAdapter(), url },\n  dataApi: { url },\n});\n\n// Use Supabase-style methods\nawait client.auth.signInWithPassword({ email, password });\n```\n\n**API Reference by Adapter:**\n\n| Adapter | Sign In | Sign Up | Get Session |\n|---------|---------|---------|-------------|\n| BetterAuthVanillaAdapter | `signIn.email({ email, password })` | `signUp.email({ email, password })` | `getSession()` |\n| BetterAuthReactAdapter | `signIn.email({ email, password })` | `signUp.email({ email, password })` | `useSession()` / `getSession()` |\n| SupabaseAuthAdapter | `signInWithPassword({ email, password })` | `signUp({ email, password })` | `getSession()` |\n\n---\n\n## Related Resources\n\n- [Auth Adapters Guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/neondatabase-labs/ai-rules/main/references/neon-js-adapters.md) - Detailed adapter comparison\n- [Import Reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/neondatabase-labs/ai-rules/main/references/neon-js-imports.md) - Complete import paths\n- [Troubleshooting Guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/neondatabase-labs/ai-rules/main/references/neon-auth-troubleshooting.md) - Error solutions\n",

      "rawContent": "# Neon Auth Setup - Next.js App Router\n\nComplete setup instructions for Neon Auth in Next.js App Router applications.\n\n---\n\n## 1. Install Package\n\n```bash\nnpm install @neondatabase/auth\n# Or: npm install @neondatabase/neon-js\n```\n\n## 2. Environment Variables\n\nCreate or update `.env.local`:\n\n```bash\nNEON_AUTH_BASE_URL=https://ep-xxx.neonauth.c-2.us-east-2.aws.neon.build/dbname/auth\nNEXT_PUBLIC_NEON_AUTH_URL=https://ep-xxx.neonauth.c-2.us-east-2.aws.neon.build/dbname/auth\n```\n\n**Important:** Both variables are needed:\n- `NEON_AUTH_BASE_URL` - Used by server-side API routes\n- `NEXT_PUBLIC_NEON_AUTH_URL` - Used by client-side components (prefixed with NEXT_PUBLIC_)\n\n**Where to find your Auth URL:**\n1. Go to your Neon project dashboard\n2. Navigate to the \"Auth\" tab\n3. Copy the Auth URL\n\n## 3. API Route Handler\n\nCreate `app/api/auth/[...path]/route.ts`:\n\n```typescript\nimport { authApiHandler } from \"@neondatabase/auth/next\";\n// Or: import { authApiHandler } from \"@neondatabase/neon-js/auth/next\";\n\nexport const { GET, POST } = authApiHandler();\n```\n\nThis creates endpoints for:\n- `/api/auth/sign-in` - Sign in\n- `/api/auth/sign-up` - Sign up\n- `/api/auth/sign-out` - Sign out\n- `/api/auth/session` - Get session\n- And other auth-related endpoints\n\n## 4. Auth Client Configuration\n\nCreate `lib/auth/client.ts`:\n\n```typescript\nimport { createAuthClient } from \"@neondatabase/auth/next\";\n// Or: import { createAuthClient } from \"@neondatabase/neon-js/auth/next\";\n\nexport const authClient = createAuthClient();\n```\n\n## 5. Use in Components\n\n```typescript\n\"use client\";\n\nimport { authClient } from \"@/lib/auth/client\";\n\nfunction AuthStatus() {\n  const session = authClient.useSession();\n\n  if (session.isPending) return <div>Loading...<\/div>;\n  if (!session.data) return <SignInButton />;\n\n  return (\n    <div>\n      <p>Hello, {session.data.user.name}<\/p>\n      <button onClick={() => authClient.signOut()}>Sign Out<\/button>\n    <\/div>\n  );\n}\n\nfunction SignInButton() {\n  return (\n    <button onClick={() => authClient.signIn.email({\n      email: \"user@example.com\",\n      password: \"password\"\n    })}>\n      Sign In\n    <\/button>\n  );\n}\n```\n\n## 6. UI Provider Setup (Optional)\n\nFor pre-built UI components (AuthView, UserButton, etc.), see the [UI Components Reference - Next.js Setup](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/neondatabase-labs/ai-rules/main/references/neon-auth-ui-nextjs.md).\n\n---\n\n## Package Selection\n\n| Need | Package | Bundle Size |\n|------|---------|-------------|\n| Auth only | `@neondatabase/auth` | Smaller (~50KB) |\n| Auth + Database queries | `@neondatabase/neon-js` | Full (~150KB) |\n\n**Recommendation:** Use `@neondatabase/auth` if you only need authentication. Use `@neondatabase/neon-js` if you also need PostgREST-style database queries.\n\n---\n\n## Related References\n\n- [UI Components - Next.js](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/neondatabase-labs/ai-rules/main/references/neon-auth-ui-nextjs.md) - Next.js UI provider setup\n- [Common Mistakes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/neondatabase-labs/ai-rules/main/references/neon-auth-common-mistakes.md) - Import paths, adapter patterns\n- [Troubleshooting Guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/neondatabase-labs/ai-rules/main/references/neon-auth-troubleshooting.md) - Error solutions\n\n---\n\n**Reference Version**: 1.1.0\n**Last Updated**: 2025-12-16\n",

      "contentPreview": "Complete setup instructions for Neon Auth in Node.js backend applications (Express, Fastify, etc.).\n---\nCreate or update :\n**Where to find your Auth URL:**\n1. Go to your Neon project dashboard\n2. Navigate to the \"Auth\" tab\n3. Copy the Auth URL\n**Important:** Add  to  if not already present.\n---\nFor ",
      "rawContent": "# Neon Auth Setup - Node.js Backend\n\nComplete setup instructions for Neon Auth in Node.js backend applications (Express, Fastify, etc.).\n\n---\n\n## 1. Install Package\n\n```bash\nnpm install @neondatabase/auth\n```\n\n## 2. Environment Variables\n\nCreate or update `.env`:\n\n```bash\nNEON_AUTH_URL=https://ep-xxx.neonauth.c-2.us-east-2.aws.neon.build/dbname/auth\n```\n\n**Where to find your Auth URL:**\n1. Go to your Neon project dashboard\n2. Navigate to the \"Auth\" tab\n3. Copy the Auth URL\n\n**Important:** Add `.env` to `.gitignore` if not already present.\n\n## 3. Auth Client Configuration\n\n```typescript\nimport { createAuthClient } from \"@neondatabase/auth\";\n\nconst auth = createAuthClient(process.env.NEON_AUTH_URL!);\n```\n\n## 4. Auth Methods\n\n### Sign Up\n\n```typescript\nconst { data, error } = await auth.signUp.email({\n  email: \"user@example.com\",\n  password: \"securepassword\",\n  name: \"John Doe\", // Optional\n});\n\nif (error) {\n  console.error(\"Sign up failed:\", error.message);\n}\n```\n\n### Sign In\n\n```typescript\n// Email/password\nconst { data, error } = await auth.signIn.email({\n  email: \"user@example.com\",\n  password: \"securepassword\",\n});\n\n// Social (Google, GitHub) - generates redirect URL\nconst { data, error } = await auth.signIn.social({\n  provider: \"google\", // or \"github\"\n  callbackURL: \"/dashboard\",\n});\n```\n\n### Sign Out\n\n```typescript\nawait auth.signOut();\n```\n\n### Get Session\n\n```typescript\nconst session = await auth.getSession();\n\nif (session) {\n  console.log(\"User:\", session.user);\n  console.log(\"Session expires:\", session.session.expiresAt);\n}\n```\n\n## 5. Express.js Example\n\n```typescript\nimport express from \"express\";\nimport { createAuthClient } from \"@neondatabase/auth\";\n\nconst app = express();\napp.use(express.json());\n\nconst auth = createAuthClient(process.env.NEON_AUTH_URL!);\n\n// Sign up endpoint\napp.post(\"/api/signup\", async (req, res) => {\n  const { email, password, name } = req.body;\n\n  const { data, error } = await auth.signUp.email({ email, password, name });\n\n  if (error) {\n    return res.status(400).json({ error: error.message });\n  }\n\n  res.json({ user: data.user });\n});\n\n// Login endpoint\napp.post(\"/api/login\", async (req, res) => {\n  const { email, password } = req.body;\n\n  const { data, error } = await auth.signIn.email({ email, password });\n\n  if (error) {\n    return res.status(401).json({ error: error.message });\n  }\n\n  res.json({ session: data });\n});\n\n// Get session endpoint\napp.get(\"/api/session\", async (req, res) => {\n  const session = await auth.getSession();\n  res.json({ session });\n});\n\n// Logout endpoint\napp.post(\"/api/logout\", async (req, res) => {\n  await auth.signOut();\n  res.json({ success: true });\n});\n\napp.listen(3000, () => {\n  console.log(\"Server running on port 3000\");\n});\n```\n\n## 6. Error Handling\n\n```typescript\nconst { data, error } = await auth.signIn.email({ email, password });\n\nif (error) {\n  switch (error.code) {\n    case \"INVALID_EMAIL_OR_PASSWORD\":\n      return res.status(401).json({ error: \"Invalid email or password\" });\n    case \"EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED\":\n      return res.status(401).json({ error: \"Please verify your email\" });\n    case \"USER_NOT_FOUND\":\n      return res.status(404).json({ error: \"User not found\" });\n    case \"TOO_MANY_REQUESTS\":\n      return res.status(429).json({ error: \"Too many attempts. Please wait.\" });\n    default:\n      return res.status(500).json({ error: \"Authentication failed\" });\n  }\n}\n```\n\n## 7. Session Data Structure\n\n```typescript\ninterface Session {\n  user: {\n    id: string;\n    name: string | null;\n    email: string;\n    image: string | null;\n    emailVerified: boolean;\n    createdAt: Date;\n    updatedAt: Date;\n  };\n  session: {\n    id: string;\n    expiresAt: Date;\n    token: string;\n    createdAt: Date;\n    updatedAt: Date;\n    userId: string;\n  };\n}\n```\n\n---\n\n## Package Selection\n\nFor backend-only use cases, `@neondatabase/auth` is recommended as it has a smaller bundle size (~50KB vs ~150KB for `@neondatabase/neon-js`).\n\nUse `@neondatabase/neon-js` only if you also need PostgREST-style database queries from the same package.\n\n---\n\n## Related References\n\n- [Common Mistakes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/neondatabase-labs/ai-rules/main/references/neon-auth-common-mistakes.md) - Import paths, configuration errors\n- [Troubleshooting Guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/neondatabase-labs/ai-rules/main/references/neon-auth-troubleshooting.md) - Error solutions\n\n---\n\n**Reference Version**: 1.1.0\n**Last Updated**: 2025-12-16\n",

      "rawContent": "# Neon Auth Setup - React SPA (Vite)\n\nComplete setup instructions for Neon Auth in React Single Page Applications (Vite, Create React App, etc.).\n\n---\n\n## 1. Install Package\n\n```bash\nnpm install @neondatabase/auth\n# Or: npm install @neondatabase/neon-js\nnpm install react-router-dom  # Required for UI components\n```\n\n## 2. Environment Variables\n\nCreate or update `.env`:\n\n**For Vite:**\n```bash\nVITE_NEON_AUTH_URL=https://ep-xxx.neonauth.c-2.us-east-2.aws.neon.build/dbname/auth\n```\n\n**For Create React App:**\n```bash\nREACT_APP_NEON_AUTH_URL=https://ep-xxx.neonauth.c-2.us-east-2.aws.neon.build/dbname/auth\n```\n\n**Where to find your Auth URL:**\n1. Go to your Neon project dashboard\n2. Navigate to the \"Auth\" tab\n3. Copy the Auth URL\n\n## 3. Auth Client Configuration\n\nCreate `src/lib/auth-client.ts`:\n\n**For `@neondatabase/auth`:**\n```typescript\nimport { createAuthClient } from \"@neondatabase/auth\";\nimport { BetterAuthReactAdapter } from \"@neondatabase/auth/react/adapters\";\n\nexport const authClient = createAuthClient(\n  import.meta.env.VITE_NEON_AUTH_URL,\n  { adapter: BetterAuthReactAdapter() }\n);\n```\n\n**For `@neondatabase/neon-js`:**\n```typescript\nimport { createClient } from \"@neondatabase/neon-js\";\nimport { BetterAuthReactAdapter } from \"@neondatabase/neon-js/auth/react/adapters\";\n\nexport const client = createClient({\n  auth: {\n    adapter: BetterAuthReactAdapter(),\n    url: import.meta.env.VITE_NEON_AUTH_URL,\n  },\n  dataApi: {\n    url: import.meta.env.VITE_NEON_DATA_API_URL,\n  },\n});\n\nexport const authClient = client.auth;\n```\n\n**Critical:**\n- `BetterAuthReactAdapter` must be imported from the `/react/adapters` subpath\n- The adapter must be called as a function: `BetterAuthReactAdapter()`\n\n## 4. Use in Components\n\n```typescript\nimport { authClient } from \"./lib/auth-client\";\n\nfunction App() {\n  const session = authClient.useSession();\n\n  if (session.isPending) return <div>Loading...<\/div>;\n  if (!session.data) return <LoginForm />;\n\n  return <Dashboard user={session.data.user} />;\n}\n```\n\n---\n\n## 5. UI Provider Setup (Optional)\n\nSkip this section if you're building custom auth forms. Use this if you want pre-built UI components.\n\n### 5a. Import CSS\n\n**CRITICAL:** Choose ONE import method. Never import both - it causes duplicate styles.\n\n**Check if the project uses Tailwind CSS** by looking for:\n- `tailwind.config.js` or `tailwind.config.ts` in the project root\n- `@import 'tailwindcss'` or `@tailwind` directives in CSS files\n- `tailwindcss` in package.json dependencies\n\n**If NOT using Tailwind** - Add to `src/main.tsx` or entry point:\n\nFor `@neondatabase/auth`:\n```typescript\nimport '@neondatabase/auth/ui/css';\n```\n\nFor `@neondatabase/neon-js`:\n```typescript\nimport '@neondatabase/neon-js/ui/css';\n```\n\n**If using Tailwind CSS v4** - Add to main CSS file (e.g., index.css):\n\nFor `@neondatabase/auth`:\n```css\n@import 'tailwindcss';\n@import '@neondatabase/auth/ui/tailwind';\n```\n\nFor `@neondatabase/neon-js`:\n```css\n@import 'tailwindcss';\n@import '@neondatabase/neon-js/ui/tailwind';\n```\n\n### 5b. Update main.tsx with BrowserRouter\n\nFor `@neondatabase/auth`:\n```tsx\nimport { createRoot } from 'react-dom/client';\nimport { BrowserRouter } from 'react-router-dom';\nimport '@neondatabase/auth/ui/css'; // if not using Tailwind\nimport App from './App';\nimport { Providers } from './providers';\n\ncreateRoot(document.getElementById('root')!).render(\n  <BrowserRouter>\n    <Providers>\n      <App />\n    <\/Providers>\n  <\/BrowserRouter>\n);\n```\n\nFor `@neondatabase/neon-js`:\n```tsx\nimport { createRoot } from 'react-dom/client';\nimport { BrowserRouter } from 'react-router-dom';\nimport '@neondatabase/neon-js/ui/css'; // if not using Tailwind\nimport App from './App';\nimport { Providers } from './providers';\n\ncreateRoot(document.getElementById('root')!).render(\n  <BrowserRouter>\n    <Providers>\n      <App />\n    <\/Providers>\n  <\/BrowserRouter>\n);\n```\n\n### 5c. Create Auth Provider\n\nCreate `src/providers.tsx`:\n\nFor `@neondatabase/auth`:\n```tsx\nimport { NeonAuthUIProvider } from '@neondatabase/auth/react/ui';\nimport { useNavigate, Link as RouterLink } from 'react-router-dom';\nimport { authClient } from './lib/auth-client';\nimport type { ReactNode } from 'react';\n\n// Adapter for react-router-dom Link\nfunction Link({ href, ...props }: { href: string } & React.AnchorHTMLAttributes<HTMLAnchorElement>) {\n  return <RouterLink to={href} {...props} />;\n}\n\nexport function Providers({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\n\n  return (\n    <NeonAuthUIProvider\n      authClient={authClient}\n      navigate={(path) => navigate(path)}\n      replace={(path) => navigate(path, { replace: true })}\n      onSessionChange={() => {\n        // Optional: refresh data or invalidate cache\n      }}\n      Link={Link}\n      social={{\n        providers: ['google', 'github']\n      }}\n    >\n      {children}\n    <\/NeonAuthUIProvider>\n  );\n}\n```\n\nFor `@neondatabase/neon-js`:\n```tsx\nimport { NeonAuthUIProvider } from '@neondatabase/neon-js/auth/react/ui';\nimport { useNavigate, Link as RouterLink } from 'react-router-dom';\nimport { authClient } from './lib/auth-client';\nimport type { ReactNode } from 'react';\n\n// Adapter for react-router-dom Link\nfunction Link({ href, ...props }: { href: string } & React.AnchorHTMLAttributes<HTMLAnchorElement>) {\n  return <RouterLink to={href} {...props} />;\n}\n\nexport function Providers({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\n\n  return (\n    <NeonAuthUIProvider\n      authClient={authClient}\n      navigate={(path) => navigate(path)}\n      replace={(path) => navigate(path, { replace: true })}\n      onSessionChange={() => {\n        // Optional: refresh data or invalidate cache\n      }}\n      Link={Link}\n      social={{\n        providers: ['google', 'github']\n      }}\n    >\n      {children}\n    <\/NeonAuthUIProvider>\n  );\n}\n```\n\n**Provider props explained:**\n- `navigate`: Function to navigate to a new route\n- `replace`: Function to replace current route (for redirects)\n- `onSessionChange`: Callback when auth state changes (useful for cache invalidation)\n- `Link`: Adapter component for react-router-dom's Link\n- `social`: Show Google and GitHub sign-in buttons (both enabled by default in Neon)\n\n### 5d. Add Routes to App.tsx\n\nFor `@neondatabase/auth`:\n```tsx\nimport { Routes, Route, useParams } from 'react-router-dom';\nimport { AuthView, UserButton, SignedIn, SignedOut } from '@neondatabase/auth/react/ui';\n\n// Auth page - handles /auth/sign-in, /auth/sign-up, etc.\nfunction AuthPage() {\n  const { pathname } = useParams();\n  return (\n    <div className=\"flex min-h-screen items-center justify-center\">\n      <AuthView pathname={pathname} />\n    <\/div>\n  );\n}\n\n// Simple navbar example\nfunction Navbar() {\n  return (\n    <nav className=\"flex items-center justify-between p-4 border-b\">\n      <a href=\"/\">My App<\/a>\n      <div className=\"flex items-center gap-4\">\n        <SignedOut>\n          <a href=\"/auth/sign-in\">Sign In<\/a>\n        <\/SignedOut>\n        <SignedIn>\n          <UserButton />\n        <\/SignedIn>\n      <\/div>\n    <\/nav>\n  );\n}\n\nfunction HomePage() {\n  return <div>Welcome to My App!<\/div>;\n}\n\nexport default function App() {\n  return (\n    <>\n      <Navbar />\n      <Routes>\n        <Route path=\"/\" element={<HomePage />} />\n        <Route path=\"/auth/:pathname\" element={<AuthPage />} />\n      <\/Routes>\n    <\/>\n  );\n}\n```\n\nFor `@neondatabase/neon-js`:\n```tsx\nimport { Routes, Route, useParams } from 'react-router-dom';\nimport { AuthView, UserButton, SignedIn, SignedOut } from '@neondatabase/neon-js/auth/react/ui';\n\n// Auth page - handles /auth/sign-in, /auth/sign-up, etc.\nfunction AuthPage() {\n  const { pathname } = useParams();\n  return (\n    <div className=\"flex min-h-screen items-center justify-center\">\n      <AuthView pathname={pathname} />\n    <\/div>\n  );\n}\n\n// Simple navbar example\nfunction Navbar() {\n  return (\n    <nav className=\"flex items-center justify-between p-4 border-b\">\n      <a href=\"/\">My App<\/a>\n      <div className=\"flex items-center gap-4\">\n        <SignedOut>\n          <a href=\"/auth/sign-in\">Sign In<\/a>\n        <\/SignedOut>\n        <SignedIn>\n          <UserButton />\n        <\/SignedIn>\n      <\/div>\n    <\/nav>\n  );\n}\n\nfunction HomePage() {\n  return <div>Welcome to My App!<\/div>;\n}\n\nexport default function App() {\n  return (\n    <>\n      <Navbar />\n      <Routes>\n        <Route path=\"/\" element={<HomePage />} />\n        <Route path=\"/auth/:pathname\" element={<AuthPage />} />\n      <\/Routes>\n    <\/>\n  );\n}\n```\n\n**Auth routes created:**\n- `/auth/sign-in` - Sign in page\n- `/auth/sign-up` - Sign up page\n- `/auth/forgot-password` - Password reset request\n- `/auth/reset-password` - Set new password\n- `/auth/sign-out` - Sign out\n- `/auth/callback` - OAuth callback (internal)\n\n---\n\n## Package Selection\n\n| Need | Package | Bundle Size |\n|------|---------|-------------|\n| Auth only | `@neondatabase/auth` | Smaller (~50KB) |\n| Auth + Database queries | `@neondatabase/neon-js` | Full (~150KB) |\n\n**Recommendation:** Use `@neondatabase/auth` if you only need authentication. Use `@neondatabase/neon-js` if you also need PostgREST-style database queries.\n\n---\n\n## Related References\n\n- [UI Components - React SPA](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/neondatabase-labs/ai-rules/main/references/neon-auth-ui-react-spa.md) - React SPA UI provider setup\n- [Common Mistakes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/neondatabase-labs/ai-rules/main/references/neon-auth-common-mistakes.md) - Import paths, adapter patterns\n- [Troubleshooting Guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/neondatabase-labs/ai-rules/main/references/neon-auth-troubleshooting.md) - Error solutions\n- [Code Generation Rules](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/neondatabase-labs/ai-rules/main/references/code-generation-rules.md) - Import and CSS strategies\n\n---\n\n**Reference Version**: 1.1.0\n**Last Updated**: 2025-12-16\n",

Add Routes to App.tsx<\/h3>\n<p>For <code>@neondatabase/auth<\/code>:<\/p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-tsx\">import { Routes, Route, useParams } from &#39;react-router-dom&#39;;\nimport { AuthView, UserButton, SignedIn, SignedOut } from &#39;@neondatabase/auth/react/ui&#39;;\n\n// Auth page - handles /auth/sign-in, /auth/sign-up, etc.\nfunction AuthPage() {\n  const { pathname } = useParams();\n  return (\n    &lt;div className=&quot;flex min-h-screen items-center justify-center&quot;&gt;\n      &lt;AuthView pathname={pathname} /&gt;\n    &lt;/div&gt;\n  );\n}\n\n// Simple navbar example\nfunction Navbar() {\n  return (\n    &lt;nav className=&quot;flex items-center justify-between p-4 border-b&quot;&gt;\n      &lt;a href=&quot;/&quot;&gt;My App&lt;/a&gt;\n      &lt;div className=&quot;flex items-center gap-4&quot;&gt;\n        &lt;SignedOut&gt;\n          &lt;a href=&quot;/auth/sign-in&quot;&gt;Sign In&lt;/a&gt;\n        &lt;/SignedOut&gt;\n        &lt;SignedIn&gt;\n          &lt;UserButton /&gt;\n        &lt;/SignedIn&gt;\n      &lt;/div&gt;\n    &lt;/nav&gt;\n  );\n}\n\nfunction HomePage() {\n  return &lt;div&gt;Welcome to My App!&lt;/div&gt;;\n}\n\nexport default function App() {\n  return (\n    &lt;&gt;\n      &lt;Navbar /&gt;\n      &lt;Routes&gt;\n        &lt;Route path=&quot;/&quot; element={&lt;HomePage /&gt;} /&gt;\n        &lt;Route path=&quot;/auth/:pathname&quot; element={&lt;AuthPage /&gt;} /&gt;\n      &lt;/Routes&gt;\n    &lt;/&gt;\n  );\n}\n<\/code><\/pre>\n<p>For <code>@neondatabase/neon-js<\/code>:<\/p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-tsx\">import { Routes, Route, useParams } from &#39;react-router-dom&#39;;\nimport { AuthView, UserButton, SignedIn, SignedOut } from &#39;@neondatabase/neon-js/auth/react/ui&#39;;\n\n// Auth page - handles /auth/sign-in, /auth/sign-up, etc.\nfunction AuthPage() {\n  const { pathname } = useParams();\n  return (\n    &lt;div className=&quot;flex min-h-screen items-center justify-center&quot;&gt;\n      &lt;AuthView pathname={pathname} /&gt;\n    &lt;/div&gt;\n  );\n}\n\n// Simple navbar example\nfunction Navbar() {\n  return (\n    &lt;nav className=&quot;flex items-center justify-between p-4 border-b&quot;&gt;\n      &lt;a href=&quot;/&quot;&gt;My App&lt;/a&gt;\n      &lt;div className=&quot;flex items-center gap-4&quot;&gt;\n        &lt;SignedOut&gt;\n          &lt;a href=&quot;/auth/sign-in&quot;&gt;Sign In&lt;/a&gt;\n        &lt;/SignedOut&gt;\n        &lt;SignedIn&gt;\n          &lt;UserButton /&gt;\n        &lt;/SignedIn&gt;\n      &lt;/div&gt;\n    &lt;/nav&gt;\n  );\n}\n\nfunction HomePage() {\n  return &lt;div&gt;Welcome to My App!&lt;/div&gt;;\n}\n\nexport default function App() {\n  return (\n    &lt;&gt;\n      &lt;Navbar /&gt;\n      &lt;Routes&gt;\n        &lt;Route path=&quot;/&quot; element={&lt;HomePage /&gt;} /&gt;\n        &lt;Route path=&quot;/auth/:pathname&quot; element={&lt;AuthPage /&gt;} /&gt;\n      &lt;/Routes&gt;\n    &lt;/&gt;\n  );\n}\n<\/code><\/pre>\n<p><strong>Auth routes created:<\/strong><\/p>\n<ul>\n<li><code>/auth/sign-in<\/code> - Sign in page<\/li>\n<li><code>/auth/sign-up<\/code> - Sign up page<\/li>\n<li><code>/auth/forgot-password<\/code> - Password reset request<\/li>\n<li><code>/auth/reset-password<\/code> - Set new password<\/li>\n<li><code>/auth/sign-out<\/code> - Sign out<\/li>\n<li><code>/auth/callback<\/code> - OAuth callback (internal)<\/li>\n<\/ul>\n<hr>\n<h2>Package Selection<\/h2>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Need<\/th>\n<th>Package<\/th>\n<th>Bundle Size<\/th>\n<\/tr>\n<\/thead>\n<tbody><tr>\n<td>Auth only<\/td>\n<td><code>@neondatabase/auth<\/code><\/td>\n<td>Smaller (~50KB)<\/td>\n<\/tr>\n<tr>\n<td>Auth + Database queries<\/td>\n<td><code>@neondatabase/neon-js<\/code><\/td>\n<td>Full (~150KB)<\/td>\n<\/tr>\n<\/tbody><\/table>\n<p><strong>Recommendation:<\/strong> Use <code>@neondatabase/auth<\/code> if you only need authentication. Use <code>@neondatabase/neon-js<\/code> if you also need PostgREST-style database queries.<\/p>\n<hr>\n<h2>Related References<\/h2>\n<ul>\n<li><a href=\"https://raw.githubusercontent.com/neondatabase-labs/ai-rules/main/references/neon-auth-ui-react-spa.md\">UI Components - React SPA<\/a> - React SPA UI provider setup<\/li>\n<li><a href=\"https://raw.githubusercontent.com/neondatabase-labs/ai-rules/main/references/neon-auth-common-mistakes.md\">Common Mistakes<\/a> - Import paths, adapter patterns<\/li>\n<li><a href=\"https://raw.githubusercontent.com/neondatabase-labs/ai-rules/main/references/neon-auth-troubleshooting.md\">Troubleshooting Guide<\/a> - Error solutions<\/li>\n<li><a href=\"https://raw.githubusercontent.com/neondatabase-labs/ai-rules/main/references/code-generation-rules.md\">Code Generation Rules<\/a> - Import and CSS strategies<\/li>\n<\/ul>\n<hr>\n<p><strong>Reference Version<\/strong>: 1.1.0\n<strong>Last Updated<\/strong>: 2025-12-16<\/p>\n"
