      "contentPreview": "Common issues and solutions for  and .\nImport Errors\nAdapter Errors\nConfiguration Errors\nSession Issues\nUI Component Issues\nData API Issues\nType Generation Issues\nDatabase Sync Issues\nSocial Auth Issues\nStill Having Issues?\n---\n**Error:**\n**Cause:** BetterAuthReactAdapter is exported from a subpath,",
      "rawContent": "# Neon Auth/JS Troubleshooting\n\nCommon issues and solutions for `@neondatabase/auth` and `@neondatabase/neon-js`.\n\n## Table of Contents\n\n- [Import Errors](#import-errors)\n- [Adapter Errors](#adapter-errors)\n- [Configuration Errors](#configuration-errors)\n- [Session Issues](#session-issues)\n- [UI Component Issues](#ui-component-issues)\n- [Data API Issues](#data-api-issues)\n- [Type Generation Issues](#type-generation-issues)\n- [Database Sync Issues](#database-sync-issues)\n- [Social Auth Issues](#social-auth-issues)\n- [Still Having Issues?](#still-having-issues)\n\n---\n\n## Import Errors\n\n### BetterAuthReactAdapter not found\n\n**Error:**\n```\nModule '\"@neondatabase/neon-js\"' has no exported member 'BetterAuthReactAdapter'\nModule '\"@neondatabase/auth\"' has no exported member 'BetterAuthReactAdapter'\n```\n\n**Cause:** BetterAuthReactAdapter is exported from a subpath, not the main entry point.\n\n**Solution:**\n```typescript\n// Wrong\nimport { BetterAuthReactAdapter } from \"@neondatabase/neon-js\";\n\n// Correct - use subpath\nimport { BetterAuthReactAdapter } from \"@neondatabase/neon-js/auth/react/adapters\";\n// Or for auth-only package:\nimport { BetterAuthReactAdapter } from \"@neondatabase/auth/react/adapters\";\n```\n\n### Cannot find module '@neondatabase/auth/next'\n\n**Error:**\n```\nCannot find module '@neondatabase/auth/next' or its corresponding type declarations\n```\n\n**Cause:** Package not installed or wrong version.\n\n**Solution:**\n```bash\n# Verify installation\nnpm list @neondatabase/auth\n\n# Reinstall if needed\nnpm install @neondatabase/auth@latest\n# Or for full SDK:\nnpm install @neondatabase/neon-js@latest\n```\n\n---\n\n## Adapter Errors\n\n### Adapter is not a function\n\n**Error:**\n```\nTypeError: adapter is not a function\n```\n\n**Cause:** Adapter passed as class instead of called as factory function.\n\n**Solution:**\n```typescript\n// Wrong\nadapter: BetterAuthReactAdapter  // Missing ()\n\n// Correct\nadapter: BetterAuthReactAdapter()  // Called as function\n```\n\n### Supabase adapter API mismatch\n\n**Error:**\n```\nTypeError: client.auth.signIn.email is not a function\n```\n\n**Cause:** Using BetterAuth API methods with SupabaseAuthAdapter.\n\n**Solution:**\n```typescript\n// BetterAuth style (default adapter)\nawait client.auth.signIn.email({ email, password });\n\n// Supabase style (with SupabaseAuthAdapter)\nawait client.auth.signInWithPassword({ email, password });\n```\n\n---\n\n## Configuration Errors\n\n### Wrong createAuthClient signature\n\n**Error:**\n```\nTypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'baseURL')\n```\n\n**Cause:** Using wrong argument structure for createAuthClient.\n\n**Solution:**\n```typescript\n// Wrong\ncreateAuthClient({ baseURL: url })\n\n// Correct (vanilla client)\ncreateAuthClient(url)\n\n// Correct (with adapter)\ncreateAuthClient(url, { adapter: BetterAuthReactAdapter() })\n\n// Correct (Next.js client - no arguments needed)\nimport { createAuthClient } from \"@neondatabase/auth/next\";\nconst authClient = createAuthClient();  // Uses env vars automatically\n```\n\n### Missing environment variables\n\n**Error:**\n```\nError: NEON_AUTH_BASE_URL is not defined\nError: NEON_DATA_API_URL is not defined\n```\n\n**Solution:**\n\nCreate `.env.local` with required variables:\n\n```bash\n# Auth\nNEON_AUTH_BASE_URL=https://ep-xxx.neonauth.c-2.us-east-2.aws.neon.build/dbname/auth\nNEXT_PUBLIC_NEON_AUTH_URL=https://ep-xxx.neonauth.c-2.us-east-2.aws.neon.build/dbname/auth\n\n# Data API (neon-js only)\nNEON_DATA_API_URL=https://ep-xxx.apirest.c-2.us-east-2.aws.neon.build/dbname/rest/v1\n```\n\nRestart development server after adding env vars.\n\n### Wrong URL format\n\n**Error:**\n```\nFetchError: request to https://... failed\n```\n\n**Common URL format issues:**\n\n1. **Auth URL should end with `/auth`:**\n   ```\n   https://ep-xxx.neonauth.*.aws.neon.build/dbname/auth\n   ```\n\n2. **Data API URL should end with `/rest/v1`:**\n   ```\n   https://ep-xxx.apirest.*.aws.neon.build/dbname/rest/v1\n   ```\n\n3. **Don't include trailing slash**\n\n---\n\n## Session Issues\n\n### Session not persisting across page refresh\n\n**Possible causes and solutions:**\n\n1. **API route not configured correctly**\n   - Verify `app/api/auth/[...path]/route.ts` exists\n   - Check route exports both GET and POST:\n   ```typescript\n   export const { GET, POST } = authApiHandler();\n   ```\n\n2. **Cookies not being set**\n   - Check browser dev tools > Application > Cookies\n   - Auth cookies should be set after sign-in\n\n3. **HTTPS required in production**\n   - Auth cookies are secure by default\n   - Use HTTPS in production, localhost works in development\n\n### useSession returns undefined\n\n**Error:**\n```\nCannot read properties of undefined (reading 'data')\n```\n\n**Solution:**\n\n1. Ensure component has `\"use client\"` directive:\n```typescript\n\"use client\";\n\nimport { authClient } from \"@/lib/auth/client\";\n\nfunction Component() {\n  const session = authClient.useSession();\n  // ...\n}\n```\n\n2. Handle loading state:\n```typescript\nconst session = authClient.useSession();\n\nif (session.isPending) return <div>Loading...<\/div>;\nif (!session.data) return <div>Not signed in<\/div>;\n\nreturn <div>Hello, {session.data.user.name}<\/div>;\n```\n\n---\n\n## UI Component Issues\n\n### CSS not loading / unstyled components\n\n**Cause:** CSS import missing or wrong import method.\n\n**Solution:**\n\nFor Tailwind projects (has `tailwind.config.{js,ts}`):\n```css\n/* In app/globals.css */\n@import '@neondatabase/neon-js/ui/tailwind';\n/* Or: @import '@neondatabase/auth/ui/tailwind'; */\n```\n\nFor non-Tailwind projects:\n```typescript\n// In app/layout.tsx\nimport \"@neondatabase/neon-js/ui/css\";\n// Or: import \"@neondatabase/auth/ui/css\";\n```\n\n**Warning:** Never use both methods - causes 94KB duplicate styles.\n\n### AuthView showing blank page\n\n**Possible causes:**\n\n1. **Missing generateStaticParams**\n```typescript\n// Required for static generation\nexport function generateStaticParams() {\n  return Object.values(authViewPaths).map((path) => ({ path }));\n}\n```\n\n2. **Wrong path parameter handling**\n```typescript\n// Next.js 15 - params is Promise\nexport default async function AuthPage({\n  params,\n}: {\n  params: Promise<{ path: string }>;\n}) {\n  const { path } = await params;\n  return <AuthView pathname={path} />;\n}\n```\n\n3. **Provider not wrapping app**\n   - Ensure `AuthProvider` wraps children in `app/layout.tsx`\n\n---\n\n## Data API Issues\n\n*These issues apply to `@neondatabase/neon-js` only.*\n\n### Query returns empty data\n\n**Possible causes:**\n\n1. **Table is empty** - Check data exists in Neon console\n2. **Wrong table name** - Table names are case-sensitive\n3. **Filters too restrictive** - Remove filters to test\n\n**Debug query:**\n```typescript\nconst { data, error, count } = await dbClient\n  .from(\"your_table\")\n  .select(\"*\", { count: \"exact\" });\n\nconsole.log({ data, error, count });\n```\n\n### Permission denied errors\n\n**Error:**\n```\nPostgrestError: permission denied for table users\n```\n\n**Cause:** Row Level Security (RLS) blocking access, or user doesn't have permissions.\n\n**Solutions:**\n\n1. **Check RLS policies** in Neon console\n2. **Ensure Data API is enabled** for the table\n3. **Verify authenticated user** has access to the resource\n\n### Table not found\n\n**Error:**\n```\nPostgrestError: relation \"tablename\" does not exist\n```\n\n**Solutions:**\n\n1. **Check table exists** in Neon console\n2. **Check schema** - Default is `public`, use `schema_name.table_name` if different\n3. **Case sensitivity** - PostgreSQL lowercases unquoted names\n4. **Enable table for Data API** in Neon console\n\n---\n\n## Type Generation Issues\n\n*These issues apply to `@neondatabase/neon-js` only.*\n\n### gen-types command fails\n\n**Error:**\n```\nError: Connection refused\n```\n\n**Solution:**\n\n1. Verify DATABASE_URL format:\n   ```\n   postgresql://user:password@host/database?sslmode=require\n   ```\n\n2. Check database is accessible from your machine\n\n3. Try with explicit parameters:\n   ```bash\n   npx neon-js gen-types \\\n     --db-url \"postgresql://user:pass@ep-xxx.us-east-2.aws.neon.tech/neondb?sslmode=require\" \\\n     --output lib/db/database.types.ts\n   ```\n\n### Types don't match schema\n\n**Cause:** Types generated from old schema.\n\n**Solution:**\n1. Re-run type generation after schema changes\n2. Add to build script:\n   ```json\n   {\n     \"scripts\": {\n       \"db:types\": \"neon-js gen-types --db-url $DATABASE_URL --output lib/db/database.types.ts\"\n     }\n   }\n   ```\n\n---\n\n## Social Auth Issues\n\n### Social login buttons don't appear\n\n**Symptoms:**\n- Only email/password form shows in AuthView\n- Expected Google/GitHub buttons are missing\n\n**Root Cause:**\nSocial buttons require TWO configurations:\n1. Provider enabled in Neon Console (Auth tab)\n2. `social` prop added to NeonAuthUIProvider\n\n**Solution:**\n1. Verify providers are enabled in Neon Console\n2. Add `social` prop: `social={{ providers: [\"google\", \"github\"] }}`\n3. Restart dev server\n\n**Common Mistake:** Assuming console configuration alone makes buttons appear.\n\n---\n\n### OAuth error when clicking social button\n\n**Cause:** Provider listed in code but not enabled in console.\n\n**Solution:** Ensure `social.providers` array only contains providers enabled in Neon Console.\n\n---\n\n### OAuth callback error\n\n**Error:**\n```\nOAuth callback failed: Invalid redirect URI\n```\n\n**Solution:**\n1. Go to your OAuth provider (Google, GitHub, etc.)\n2. Add these redirect URIs:\n   - Development: `http://localhost:3000/api/auth/callback/[provider]`\n   - Production: `https://yourdomain.com/api/auth/callback/[provider]`\n\n3. Verify OAuth credentials are configured in Neon dashboard\n\n---\n\n## Still Having Issues?\n\n1. **Check versions:**\n   ```bash\n   npm list @neondatabase/auth @neondatabase/neon-js\n   ```\n\n2. **Clear caches:**\n   ```bash\n   rm -rf node_modules/.cache .next\n   npm install\n   ```\n\n3. **Reference documentation:**\n   - [Common Mistakes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/neondatabase-labs/ai-rules/main/references/neon-auth-common-mistakes.md)\n   - [neon-auth.mdc](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/neondatabase-labs/ai-rules/main/neon-auth.mdc) - Auth patterns\n   - [neon-js.mdc](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/neondatabase-labs/ai-rules/main/neon-js.mdc) - Full SDK reference\n\n4. **Check Neon status:**\n   - Verify services are running in Neon console\n   - Check Auth and Data API are enabled for your project\n",
      "renderedContent": "<h1>Neon Auth/JS Troubleshooting<\/h1>\n<p>Common issues and solutions for <code>@neondatabase/auth<\/code> and <code>@neondatabase/neon-js<\/code>.<\/p>\n<h2>Table of Contents<\/h2>\n<ul>\n<li><a href=\"#import-errors\">Import Errors<\/a><\/li>\n<li><a href=\"#adapter-errors\">Adapter Errors<\/a><\/li>\n<li><a href=\"#configuration-errors\">Configuration Errors<\/a><\/li>\n<li><a href=\"#session-issues\">Session Issues<\/a><\/li>\n<li><a href=\"#ui-component-issues\">UI Component Issues<\/a><\/li>\n<li><a href=\"#data-api-issues\">Data API Issues<\/a><\/li>\n<li><a href=\"#type-generation-issues\">Type Generation Issues<\/a><\/li>\n<li><a href=\"#database-sync-issues\">Database Sync Issues<\/a><\/li>\n<li><a href=\"#social-auth-issues\">Social Auth Issues<\/a><\/li>\n<li><a href=\"#still-having-issues\">Still Having Issues?<\/a><\/li>\n<\/ul>\n<hr>\n<h2>Import Errors<\/h2>\n<h3>BetterAuthReactAdapter not found<\/h3>\n<p><strong>Error:<\/strong><\/p>\n<pre><code>Module &#39;&quot;@neondatabase/neon-js&quot;&#39; has no exported member &#39;BetterAuthReactAdapter&#39;\nModule &#39;&quot;@neondatabase/auth&quot;&#39; has no exported member &#39;BetterAuthReactAdapter&#39;\n<\/code><\/pre>\n<p><strong>Cause:<\/strong> BetterAuthReactAdapter is exported from a subpath, not the main entry point.<\/p>\n<p><strong>Solution:<\/strong><\/p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-typescript\">// Wrong\nimport { BetterAuthReactAdapter } from &quot;@neondatabase/neon-js&quot;;\n\n// Correct - use subpath\nimport { BetterAuthReactAdapter } from &quot;@neondatabase/neon-js/auth/react/adapters&quot;;\n// Or for auth-only package:\nimport { BetterAuthReactAdapter } from &quot;@neondatabase/auth/react/adapters&quot;;\n<\/code><\/pre>\n<h3>Cannot find module &#39;@neondatabase/auth/next&#39;<\/h3>\n<p><strong>Error:<\/strong><\/p>\n<pre><code>Cannot find module &#39;@neondatabase/auth/next&#39; or its corresponding type declarations\n<\/code><\/pre>\n<p><strong>Cause:<\/strong> Package not installed or wrong version.<\/p>\n<p><strong>Solution:<\/strong><\/p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-bash\"># Verify installation\nnpm list @neondatabase/auth\n\n# Reinstall if needed\nnpm install @neondatabase/auth@latest\n# Or for full SDK:\nnpm install @neondatabase/neon-js@latest\n<\/code><\/pre>\n<hr>\n<h2>Adapter Errors<\/h2>\n<h3>Adapter is not a function<\/h3>\n<p><strong>Error:<\/strong><\/p>\n<pre><code>TypeError: adapter is not a function\n<\/code><\/pre>\n<p><strong>Cause:<\/strong> Adapter passed as class instead of called as factory function.<\/p>\n<p><strong>Solution:<\/strong><\/p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-typescript\">// Wrong\nadapter: BetterAuthReactAdapter  // Missing ()\n\n// Correct\nadapter: BetterAuthReactAdapter()  // Called as function\n<\/code><\/pre>\n<h3>Supabase adapter API mismatch<\/h3>\n<p><strong>Error:<\/strong><\/p>\n<pre><code>TypeError: client.auth.signIn.email is not a function\n<\/code><\/pre>\n<p><strong>Cause:<\/strong> Using BetterAuth API methods with SupabaseAuthAdapter.<\/p>\n<p><strong>Solution:<\/strong><\/p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-typescript\">// BetterAuth style (default adapter)\nawait client.auth.signIn.email({ email, password });\n\n// Supabase style (with SupabaseAuthAdapter)\nawait client.auth.signInWithPassword({ email, password });\n<\/code><\/pre>\n<hr>\n<h2>Configuration Errors<\/h2>\n<h3>Wrong createAuthClient signature<\/h3>\n<p><strong>Error:<\/strong><\/p>\n<pre><code>TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading &#39;baseURL&#39;)\n<\/code><\/pre>\n<p><strong>Cause:<\/strong> Using wrong argument structure for createAuthClient.<\/p>\n<p><strong>Solution:<\/strong><\/p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-typescript\">// Wrong\ncreateAuthClient({ baseURL: url })\n\n// Correct (vanilla client)\ncreateAuthClient(url)\n\n// Correct (with adapter)\ncreateAuthClient(url, { adapter: BetterAuthReactAdapter() })\n\n// Correct (Next.js client - no arguments needed)\nimport { createAuthClient } from &quot;@neondatabase/auth/next&quot;;\nconst authClient = createAuthClient();  // Uses env vars automatically\n<\/code><\/pre>\n<h3>Missing environment variables<\/h3>\n<p><strong>Error:<\/strong><\/p>\n<pre><code>Error: NEON_AUTH_BASE_URL is not defined\nError: NEON_DATA_API_URL is not defined\n<\/code><\/pre>\n<p><strong>Solution:<\/strong><\/p>\n<p>Create <code>.env.local<\/code> with required variables:<\/p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-bash\"># Auth\nNEON_AUTH_BASE_URL=https://ep-xxx.neonauth.c-2.us-east-2.aws.neon.build/dbname/auth\nNEXT_PUBLIC_NEON_AUTH_URL=https://ep-xxx.neonauth.c-2.us-east-2.aws.neon.build/dbname/auth\n\n# Data API (neon-js only)\nNEON_DATA_API_URL=https://ep-xxx.apirest.c-2.us-east-2.aws.neon.build/dbname/rest/v1\n<\/code><\/pre>\n<p>Restart development server after adding env vars.<\/p>\n<h3>Wrong URL format<\/h3>\n<p><strong>Error:<\/strong><\/p>\n<pre><code>FetchError: request to https://... failed\n<\/code><\/pre>\n<p><strong>Common URL format issues:<\/strong><\/p>\n<ol>\n<li><p><strong>Auth URL should end with <code>/auth<\/code>:<\/strong><\/p>\n<pre><code>https://ep-xxx.neonauth.*.aws.neon.build/dbname/auth\n<\/code><\/pre>\n<\/li>\n<li><p><strong>Data API URL should end with <code>/rest/v1<\/code>:<\/strong><\/p>\n<pre><code>https://ep-xxx.apirest.*.aws.neon.build/dbname/rest/v1\n<\/code><\/pre>\n<\/li>\n<li><p><strong>Don&#39;t include trailing slash<\/strong><\/p>\n<\/li>\n<\/ol>\n<hr>\n<h2>Session Issues<\/h2>\n<h3>Session not persisting across page refresh<\/h3>\n<p><strong>Possible causes and solutions:<\/strong><\/p>\n<ol>\n<li><p><strong>API route not configured correctly<\/strong><\/p>\n<ul>\n<li>Verify <code>app/api/auth/[...path]/route.ts<\/code> exists<\/li>\n<li>Check route exports both GET and POST:<\/li>\n<\/ul>\n<pre><code class=\"language-typescript\">export const { GET, POST } = authApiHandler();\n<\/code><\/pre>\n<\/li>\n<li><p><strong>Cookies not being set<\/strong><\/p>\n<ul>\n<li>Check browser dev tools &gt; Application &gt; Cookies<\/li>\n<li>Auth cookies should be set after sign-in<\/li>\n<\/ul>\n<\/li>\n<li><p><strong>HTTPS required in production<\/strong><\/p>\n<ul>\n<li>Auth cookies are secure by default<\/li>\n<li>Use HTTPS in production, localhost works in development<\/li>\n<\/ul>\n<\/li>\n<\/ol>\n<h3>useSession returns undefined<\/h3>\n<p><strong>Error:<\/strong><\/p>\n<pre><code>Cannot read properties of undefined (reading &#39;data&#39;)\n<\/code><\/pre>\n<p><strong>Solution:<\/strong><\/p>\n<ol>\n<li>Ensure component has <code>&quot;use client&quot;<\/code> directive:<\/li>\n<\/ol>\n<pre><code class=\"language-typescript\">&quot;use client&quot;;\n\nimport { authClient } from &quot;@/lib/auth/client&quot;;\n\nfunction Component() {\n  const session = authClient.useSession();\n  // ...\n}\n<\/code><\/pre>\n<ol start=\"2\">\n<li>Handle loading state:<\/li>\n<\/ol>\n<pre><code class=\"language-typescript\">const session = authClient.useSession();\n\nif (session.isPending) return &lt;div&gt;Loading...&lt;/div&gt;;\nif (!session.data) return &lt;div&gt;Not signed in&lt;/div&gt;;\n\nreturn &lt;div&gt;Hello, {session.data.user.name}&lt;/div&gt;;\n<\/code><\/pre>\n<hr>\n<h2>UI Component Issues<\/h2>\n<h3>CSS not loading / unstyled components<\/h3>\n<p><strong>Cause:<\/strong> CSS import missing or wrong import method.<\/p>\n<p><strong>Solution:<\/strong><\/p>\n<p>For Tailwind projects (has <code>tailwind.config.{js,ts}<\/code>):<\/p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-css\">/* In app/globals.css */\n@import &#39;@neondatabase/neon-js/ui/tailwind&#39;;\n/* Or: @import &#39;@neondatabase/auth/ui/tailwind&#39;; */\n<\/code><\/pre>\n<p>For non-Tailwind projects:<\/p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-typescript\">// In app/layout.tsx\nimport &quot;@neondatabase/neon-js/ui/css&quot;;\n// Or: import &quot;@neondatabase/auth/ui/css&quot;;\n<\/code><\/pre>\n<p><strong>Warning:<\/strong> Never use both methods - causes 94KB duplicate styles.<\/p>\n<h3>AuthView showing blank page<\/h3>\n<p><strong>Possible causes:<\/strong><\/p>\n<ol>\n<li><strong>Missing generateStaticParams<\/strong><\/li>\n<\/ol>\n<pre><code class=\"language-typescript\">// Required for static generation\nexport function generateStaticParams() {\n  return Object.values(authViewPaths).map((path) =&gt; ({ path }));\n}\n<\/code><\/pre>\n<ol start=\"2\">\n<li><strong>Wrong path parameter handling<\/strong><\/li>\n<\/ol>\n<pre><code class=\"language-typescript\">// Next.js 15 - params is Promise\nexport default async function AuthPage({\n  params,\n}: {\n  params: Promise&lt;{ path: string }&gt;;\n}) {\n  const { path } = await params;\n  return &lt;AuthView pathname={path} /&gt;;\n}\n<\/code><\/pre>\n<ol start=\"3\">\n<li><strong>Provider not wrapping app<\/strong><ul>\n<li>Ensure <code>AuthProvider<\/code> wraps children in <code>app/layout.tsx<\/code><\/li>\n<\/ul>\n<\/li>\n<\/ol>\n<hr>\n<h2>Data API Issues<\/h2>\n<p><em>These issues apply to <code>@neondatabase/neon-js<\/code> only.<\/em><\/p>\n<h3>Query returns empty data<\/h3>\n<p><strong>Possible causes:<\/strong><\/p>\n<ol>\n<li><strong>Table is empty<\/strong> - Check data exists in Neon console<\/li>\n<li><strong>Wrong table name<\/strong> - Table names are case-sensitive<\/li>\n<li><strong>Filters too restrictive<\/strong> - Remove filters to test<\/li>\n<\/ol>\n<p><strong>Debug query:<\/strong><\/p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-typescript\">const { data, error, count } = await dbClient\n  .from(&quot;your_table&quot;)\n  .select(&quot;*&quot;, { count: &quot;exact&quot; });\n\nconsole.log({ data, error, count });\n<\/code><\/pre>\n<h3>Permission denied errors<\/h3>\n<p><strong>Error:<\/strong><\/p>\n<pre><code>PostgrestError: permission denied for table users\n<\/code><\/pre>\n<p><strong>Cause:<\/strong> Row Level Security (RLS) blocking access, or user doesn&#39;t have permissions.<\/p>\n<p><strong>Solutions:<\/strong><\/p>\n<ol>\n<li><strong>Check RLS policies<\/strong> in Neon console<\/li>\n<li><strong>Ensure Data API is enabled<\/strong> for the table<\/li>\n<li><strong>Verify authenticated user<\/strong> has access to the resource<\/li>\n<\/ol>\n<h3>Table not found<\/h3>\n<p><strong>Error:<\/strong><\/p>\n<pre><code>PostgrestError: relation &quot;tablename&quot; does not exist\n<\/code><\/pre>\n<p><strong>Solutions:<\/strong><\/p>\n<ol>\n<li><strong>Check table exists<\/strong> in Neon console<\/li>\n<li><strong>Check schema<\/strong> - Default is <code>public<\/code>, use <code>schema_name.table_name<\/code> if different<\/li>\n<li><strong>Case sensitivity<\/strong> - PostgreSQL lowercases unquoted names<\/li>\n<li><strong>Enable table for Data API<\/strong> in Neon console<\/li>\n<\/ol>\n<hr>\n<h2>Type Generation Issues<\/h2>\n<p><em>These issues apply to <code>@neondatabase/neon-js<\/code> only.<\/em><\/p>\n<h3>gen-types command fails<\/h3>\n<p><strong>Error:<\/strong><\/p>\n<pre><code>Error: Connection refused\n<\/code><\/pre>\n<p><strong>Solution:<\/strong><\/p>\n<ol>\n<li><p>Verify DATABASE_URL format:<\/p>\n<pre><code>postgresql://user:password@host/database?sslmode=require\n<\/code><\/pre>\n<\/li>\n<li><p>Check database is accessible from your machine<\/p>\n<\/li>\n<li><p>Try with explicit parameters:<\/p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-bash\">npx neon-js gen-types \\\n  --db-url &quot;postgresql://user:pass@ep-xxx.us-east-2.aws.neon.tech/neondb?sslmode=require&quot; \\\n  --output lib/db/database.types.ts\n<\/code><\/pre>\n<\/li>\n<\/ol>\n<h3>Types don&#39;t match schema<\/h3>\n<p><strong>Cause:<\/strong> Types generated from old schema.<\/p>\n<p><strong>Solution:<\/strong><\/p>\n<ol>\n<li>Re-run type generation after schema changes<\/li>\n<li>Add to build script:<pre><code class=\"language-json\">{\n  &quot;scripts&quot;: {\n    &quot;db:types&quot;: &quot;neon-js gen-types --db-url $DATABASE_URL --output lib/db/database.types.ts&quot;\n  }\n}\n<\/code><\/pre>\n<\/li>\n<\/ol>\n<hr>\n<h2>Social Auth Issues<\/h2>\n<h3>Social       "contentPreview": "Complete UI setup guide for Neon Auth in Next.js App Router applications.\n---\n**If using Tailwind:**\n**If NOT using Tailwind:**\n**Warning:** Never import both - causes 94KB of duplicate styles.\nCreate :\nUpdate :\nCreate :\nThis creates routes: , , , etc.\n---\n| Prop | Type | Required | Description |\n|-",
      "rawContent": "# Neon Auth UI - Next.js App Router\n\nComplete UI setup guide for Neon Auth in Next.js App Router applications.\n\n---\n\n## Quick Setup\n\n### 1. Import CSS\n\n**If using Tailwind:**\n```css\n/* In app/globals.css */\n@import '@neondatabase/auth/ui/tailwind';\n```\n\n**If NOT using Tailwind:**\n```typescript\n// In app/layout.tsx\nimport \"@neondatabase/auth/ui/css\";\n```\n\n**Warning:** Never import both - causes 94KB of duplicate styles.\n\n### 2. Create Provider\n\nCreate `app/auth-provider.tsx`:\n\n```tsx\n\"use client\";\n\nimport { NeonAuthUIProvider } from \"@neondatabase/auth/react/ui\";\nimport { authClient } from \"@/lib/auth/client\";\nimport { useRouter } from \"next/navigation\";\nimport Link from \"next/link\";\n\nexport function AuthProvider({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {\n  const router = useRouter();\n\n  return (\n    <NeonAuthUIProvider\n      authClient={authClient}\n      navigate={router.push}\n      replace={router.replace}\n      onSessionChange={() => router.refresh()}\n      Link={Link}\n      social={{\n        providers: [\"google\", \"github\"]\n      }}\n    >\n      {children}\n    <\/NeonAuthUIProvider>\n  );\n}\n```\n\n### 3. Wrap App\n\nUpdate `app/layout.tsx`:\n\n```tsx\nimport { AuthProvider } from \"./auth-provider\";\n\nexport default function RootLayout({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {\n  return (\n    <html lang=\"en\">\n      <body>\n        <AuthProvider>{children}<\/AuthProvider>\n      <\/body>\n    <\/html>\n  );\n}\n```\n\n### 4. Create Auth Pages\n\nCreate `app/auth/[path]/page.tsx`:\n\n```tsx\nimport { AuthView } from \"@neondatabase/auth/react/ui\";\nimport { authViewPaths } from \"@neondatabase/auth/react/ui/server\";\n\nexport const dynamicParams = false;\n\nexport function generateStaticParams() {\n  return Object.values(authViewPaths).map((path) => ({ path }));\n}\n\nexport default async function AuthPage({\n  params,\n}: {\n  params: Promise<{ path: string }>;\n}) {\n  const { path } = await params;\n  return <AuthView pathname={path} />;\n}\n```\n\nThis creates routes: `/auth/sign-in`, `/auth/sign-up`, `/auth/forgot-password`, etc.\n\n---\n\n## Provider Configuration\n\n### Props Reference\n\n| Prop | Type | Required | Description |\n|------|------|----------|-------------|\n| `authClient` | `AuthClient` | Yes | The auth client instance from `createAuthClient()` |\n| `navigate` | `(path: string) => void` | Yes | Function to navigate to a new route |\n| `replace` | `(path: string) => void` | Yes | Function to replace current route (for redirects) |\n| `Link` | `Component` | Yes | Next.js Link component |\n| `onSessionChange` | `() => void` | No | Callback fired when authentication state changes |\n| `avatar` | `{ upload: (file: File) => Promise<string> }` | No | Avatar upload configuration |\n| `social` | `{ providers: string[] }` | No | Social login providers to display |\n\n### Social Login\n\n```tsx\n<NeonAuthUIProvider\n  social={{\n    providers: [\"google\", \"github\"]\n  }}\n>\n```\n\n**Note:** Social buttons require TWO configurations:\n1. Enable providers in Neon Console (Auth tab)\n2. Add the `social` prop shown above to display buttons\n\n### Avatar Upload\n\n```tsx\n<NeonAuthUIProvider\n  avatar={{\n    upload: async (file: File) => {\n      const formData = new FormData();\n      formData.append(\"file\", file);\n      const response = await fetch(\"/api/upload\", {\n        method: \"POST\",\n        body: formData,\n      });\n      const { url } = await response.json();\n      return url;\n    },\n  }}\n>\n```\n\n---\n\n## UI Components\n\n### Authentication\n\n```tsx\nimport { AuthView, SignInForm, SignUpForm } from \"@neondatabase/auth/react/ui\";\n\n// Full auth view (recommended)\n<AuthView pathname=\"sign-in\" />\n\n// Individual forms\n<SignInForm />\n<SignUpForm />\n```\n\n### User Components\n\n```tsx\nimport { UserButton, UserAvatar, SignedIn, SignedOut } from \"@neondatabase/auth/react/ui\";\n\nfunction Navbar() {\n  return (\n    <nav>\n      <SignedOut>\n        <a href=\"/auth/sign-in\">Sign In<\/a>\n      <\/SignedOut>\n      <SignedIn>\n        <UserButton />\n      <\/SignedIn>\n    <\/nav>\n  );\n}\n```\n\n### Protected Routes\n\n```tsx\nimport { RedirectToSignIn, SignedIn } from \"@neondatabase/auth/react/ui\";\n\nfunction ProtectedPage() {\n  return (\n    <>\n      <RedirectToSignIn />\n      <SignedIn>\n        <p>Protected content<\/p>\n      <\/SignedIn>\n    <\/>\n  );\n}\n```\n\n### Account Settings\n\n```tsx\nimport { AccountView, SettingsCards } from \"@neondatabase/auth/react/ui\";\n\n// Full account view\n<AccountView pathname=\"settings\" />\n\n// Or individual cards\nimport {\n  UpdateAvatarCard,\n  UpdateNameCard,\n  ChangeEmailCard,\n  ChangePasswordCard,\n  SessionsCard,\n  DeleteAccountCard\n} from \"@neondatabase/auth/react/ui\";\n```\n\n---\n\n## CSS Variables\n\nAuth UI **automatically inherits your app's existing theme**. If you have CSS variables like `--primary`, `--background`, etc. defined (from Tailwind, shadcn/ui, or custom CSS), auth components use them with no configuration.\n\nImport order doesn't matter - auth styles are in `@layer neon-auth`, so your styles always win.\n\n### Use in Custom Components\n\n| Variable | Purpose |\n|----------|---------|\n| `--background`, `--foreground` | Page background/text |\n| `--card`, `--card-foreground` | Card surfaces |\n| `--primary`, `--primary-foreground` | Primary buttons |\n| `--muted`, `--muted-foreground` | Muted elements |\n| `--border`, `--ring` | Borders and focus rings |\n| `--radius` | Border radius |\n\n**Usage:**\n```css\nbackground: var(--background);\ncolor: var(--foreground);\n```\n\n### Auth-Specific Customization\n\nTo customize auth components differently from your main app, use `--neon-*` prefix:\n```css\n:root {\n  --neon-primary: oklch(0.55 0.18 145);  /* Only affects auth */\n}\n```\n\n**Dark mode:** Add the `dark` class to `<html>` or `<body>`.\n\n---\n\n## Import Paths\n\n| What | Import Path |\n|------|-------------|\n| UI Provider | `@neondatabase/auth/react/ui` |\n| Components | `@neondatabase/auth/react/ui` |\n| Server utilities | `@neondatabase/auth/react/ui/server` |\n| CSS | `@neondatabase/auth/ui/css` |\n| Tailwind | `@neondatabase/auth/ui/tailwind` |\n\n---\n\n## Related References\n\n- [Setup - Next.js](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/neondatabase-labs/ai-rules/main/references/neon-auth-setup-nextjs.md) - Auth client setup\n- [Common Mistakes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/neondatabase-labs/ai-rules/main/references/neon-auth-common-mistakes.md) - Import paths, adapter patterns\n- [Troubleshooting](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/neondatabase-labs/ai-rules/main/references/neon-auth-troubleshooting.md) - Error solutions\n\n---\n\n**Reference Version**: 1.1.0\n**Last Updated**: 2025-12-16\n",

      "contentPreview": "Complete UI setup guide for Neon Auth in React Single Page Applications.\n---\n**If using Tailwind CSS v4:**\n**If NOT using Tailwind:**\n**Warning:** Never import both - causes duplicate styles.\nCreate :\nUpdate :\n**Auth routes created:**\n- Sign in page\n- Sign up page\n- Password reset request\n- Set new ",
      "rawContent": "# Neon Auth UI - React SPA (Vite)\n\nComplete UI setup guide for Neon Auth in React Single Page Applications.\n\n---\n\n## Quick Setup\n\n### 1. Install Dependencies\n\n```bash\nnpm install react-router-dom\n```\n\n### 2. Import CSS\n\n**If using Tailwind CSS v4:**\n```css\n/* In index.css */\n@import 'tailwindcss';\n@import '@neondatabase/auth/ui/tailwind';\n```\n\n**If NOT using Tailwind:**\n```typescript\n// In src/main.tsx\nimport '@neondatabase/auth/ui/css';\n```\n\n**Warning:** Never import both - causes duplicate styles.\n\n### 3. Update main.tsx with BrowserRouter\n\n```tsx\nimport { createRoot } from 'react-dom/client';\nimport { BrowserRouter } from 'react-router-dom';\nimport '@neondatabase/auth/ui/css'; // if not using Tailwind\nimport App from './App';\nimport { Providers } from './providers';\n\ncreateRoot(document.getElementById('root')!).render(\n  <BrowserRouter>\n    <Providers>\n      <App />\n    <\/Providers>\n  <\/BrowserRouter>\n);\n```\n\n### 4. Create Provider\n\nCreate `src/providers.tsx`:\n\n```tsx\nimport { NeonAuthUIProvider } from '@neondatabase/auth/react/ui';\nimport { useNavigate, Link as RouterLink } from 'react-router-dom';\nimport { authClient } from './lib/auth-client';\nimport type { ReactNode } from 'react';\n\n// Adapter for react-router-dom Link\nfunction Link({ href, ...props }: { href: string } & React.AnchorHTMLAttributes<HTMLAnchorElement>) {\n  return <RouterLink to={href} {...props} />;\n}\n\nexport function Providers({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\n\n  return (\n    <NeonAuthUIProvider\n      authClient={authClient}\n      navigate={(path) => navigate(path)}\n      replace={(path) => navigate(path, { replace: true })}\n      onSessionChange={() => {\n        // Optional: invalidate queries, refetch data\n      }}\n      Link={Link}\n      social={{\n        providers: ['google', 'github']\n      }}\n    >\n      {children}\n    <\/NeonAuthUIProvider>\n  );\n}\n```\n\n### 5. Add Routes\n\nUpdate `src/App.tsx`:\n\n```tsx\nimport { Routes, Route, useParams } from 'react-router-dom';\nimport { AuthView, UserButton, SignedIn, SignedOut } from '@neondatabase/auth/react/ui';\n\nfunction AuthPage() {\n  const { pathname } = useParams();\n  return (\n    <div className=\"flex min-h-screen items-center justify-center\">\n      <AuthView pathname={pathname} />\n    <\/div>\n  );\n}\n\nfunction Navbar() {\n  return (\n    <nav className=\"flex items-center justify-between p-4 border-b\">\n      <a href=\"/\">My App<\/a>\n      <div className=\"flex items-center gap-4\">\n        <SignedOut>\n          <a href=\"/auth/sign-in\">Sign In<\/a>\n        <\/SignedOut>\n        <SignedIn>\n          <UserButton />\n        <\/SignedIn>\n      <\/div>\n    <\/nav>\n  );\n}\n\nexport default function App() {\n  return (\n    <>\n      <Navbar />\n      <Routes>\n        <Route path=\"/\" element={<div>Home<\/div>} />\n        <Route path=\"/auth/:pathname\" element={<AuthPage />} />\n      <\/Routes>\n    <\/>\n  );\n}\n```\n\n**Auth routes created:**\n- `/auth/sign-in` - Sign in page\n- `/auth/sign-up` - Sign up page\n- `/auth/forgot-password` - Password reset request\n- `/auth/reset-password` - Set new password\n- `/auth/sign-out` - Sign out\n- `/auth/callback` - OAuth callback (internal)\n\n---\n\n## Provider Configuration\n\n### Props Reference\n\n| Prop | Type | Required | Description |\n|------|------|----------|-------------|\n| `authClient` | `AuthClient` | Yes | The auth client instance |\n| `navigate` | `(path: string) => void` | Yes | react-router's navigate function |\n| `replace` | `(path: string) => void` | Yes | Navigate with replace |\n| `Link` | `Component` | Yes | Link adapter (see above) |\n| `onSessionChange` | `() => void` | No | Auth state change callback |\n| `avatar` | `{ upload: (file: File) => Promise<string> }` | No | Avatar upload config |\n| `social` | `{ providers: string[] }` | No | Social login providers |\n\n### Social Login\n\n```tsx\n<NeonAuthUIProvider\n  social={{\n    providers: ['google', 'github']\n  }}\n>\n```\n\n**Note:** Social buttons require TWO configurations:\n1. Enable providers in Neon Console (Auth tab)\n2. Add the `social` prop shown above to display buttons\n\n### Avatar Upload\n\n```tsx\n<NeonAuthUIProvider\n  avatar={{\n    upload: async (file: File) => {\n      const formData = new FormData();\n      formData.append(\"file\", file);\n      const response = await fetch(\"/api/upload\", {\n        method: \"POST\",\n        body: formData,\n      });\n      const { url } = await response.json();\n      return url;\n    },\n  }}\n>\n```\n\n---\n\n## UI Components\n\n### Authentication\n\n```tsx\nimport { AuthView, SignInForm, SignUpForm } from '@neondatabase/auth/react/ui';\n\n// Full auth view (recommended)\n<AuthView pathname=\"sign-in\" />\n\n// Individual forms\n<SignInForm />\n<SignUpForm />\n```\n\n### User Components\n\n```tsx\nimport { UserButton, UserAvatar, SignedIn, SignedOut } from '@neondatabase/auth/react/ui';\n\n<SignedOut>\n  <a href=\"/auth/sign-in\">Sign In<\/a>\n<\/SignedOut>\n<SignedIn>\n  <UserButton />\n<\/SignedIn>\n```\n\n### Protected Routes\n\n```tsx\nimport { RedirectToSignIn, SignedIn } from '@neondatabase/auth/react/ui';\n\nfunction ProtectedPage() {\n  return (\n    <>\n      <RedirectToSignIn />\n      <SignedIn>\n        <p>Protected content<\/p>\n      <\/SignedIn>\n    <\/>\n  );\n}\n```\n\n### Account Settings\n\n```tsx\nimport { AccountView, SettingsCards } from '@neondatabase/auth/react/ui';\n\n// Full account view\n<AccountView pathname=\"settings\" />\n\n// Or individual cards\nimport {\n  UpdateAvatarCard,\n  UpdateNameCard,\n  ChangeEmailCard,\n  ChangePasswordCard,\n  SessionsCard,\n  DeleteAccountCard\n} from '@neondatabase/auth/react/ui';\n```\n\n---\n\n## TanStack Router Setup\n\nIf using TanStack Router instead of react-router-dom:\n\n```tsx\nimport { NeonAuthUIProvider } from \"@neondatabase/auth/react/ui\";\nimport { useRouter, Link as TanStackLink } from \"@tanstack/react-router\";\nimport { authClient } from \"./lib/auth-client\";\n\nfunction Link({ href, ...props }: { href: string } & React.AnchorHTMLAttributes<HTMLAnchorElement>) {\n  return <TanStackLink to={href} {...props} />;\n}\n\nexport function Providers({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {\n  const router = useRouter();\n\n  return (\n    <NeonAuthUIProvider\n      authClient={authClient}\n      navigate={(path) => router.navigate({ to: path })}\n      replace={(path) => router.navigate({ to: path, replace: true })}\n      Link={Link}\n    >\n      {children}\n    <\/NeonAuthUIProvider>\n  );\n}\n```\n\n---\n\n## CSS Variables\n\nAuth UI **automatically inherits your app's existing theme**. If you have CSS variables like `--primary`, `--background`, etc. defined (from Tailwind, shadcn/ui, or custom CSS), auth components use them with no configuration.\n\nImport order doesn't matter - auth styles are in `@layer neon-auth`, so your styles always win.\n\n### Use in Custom Components\n\n| Variable | Purpose |\n|----------|---------|\n| `--background`, `--foreground` | Page background/text |\n| `--card`, `--card-foreground` | Card surfaces |\n| `--primary`, `--primary-foreground` | Primary buttons |\n| `--muted`, `--muted-foreground` | Muted elements |\n| `--border`, `--ring` | Borders and focus rings |\n| `--radius` | Border radius |\n\n**Usage:**\n```css\nbackground: var(--background);\ncolor: var(--foreground);\n```\n\n### Auth-Specific Customization\n\nTo customize auth components differently from your main app, use `--neon-*` prefix:\n```css\n:root {\n  --neon-primary: oklch(0.55 0.18 145);  /* Only affects auth */\n}\n```\n\n**Dark mode:** Add the `dark` class to `<html>` or `<body>`.\n\n---\n\n## Import Paths\n\n| What | Import Path |\n|------|-------------|\n| UI Provider | `@neondatabase/auth/react/ui` |\n| Components | `@neondatabase/auth/react/ui` |\n| CSS | `@neondatabase/auth/ui/css` |\n| Tailwind | `@neondatabase/auth/ui/tailwind` |\n| React Adapter | `@neondatabase/auth/react/adapters` |\n\n---\n\n## Related References\n\n- [Setup - React SPA](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/neondatabase-labs/ai-rules/main/references/neon-auth-setup-react-spa.md) - Auth client setup\n- [Common Mistakes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/neondatabase-labs/ai-rules/main/references/neon-auth-common-mistakes.md) - Import paths, adapter patterns\n- [Troubleshooting](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/neondatabase-labs/ai-rules/main/references/neon-auth-troubleshooting.md) - Error solutions\n\n---\n\n**Reference Version**: 1.1.0\n**Last Updated**: 2025-12-16\n",

      "contentPreview": "Three adapters available for different API styles. **All adapters are factory functions that must be called with .**\nUsed automatically when no adapter is specified. Best for Node.js backends and non-React environments.\nProvides React hooks for state management. **Must import from subpath.**\nProvide",
      "rawContent": "# Neon JS SDK - Auth Adapters\n\nThree adapters available for different API styles. **All adapters are factory functions that must be called with `()`.**\n\n## BetterAuthVanillaAdapter (Default)\n\nUsed automatically when no adapter is specified. Best for Node.js backends and non-React environments.\n\n```typescript\nimport { createClient } from \"@neondatabase/neon-js\";\n\n// Default adapter - no need to specify\nconst client = createClient({\n  auth: { url: process.env.NEON_AUTH_URL! },\n  dataApi: { url: process.env.NEON_DATA_API_URL! },\n});\n\n// Auth methods\nawait client.auth.signIn.email({ email, password });\nawait client.auth.signUp.email({ email, password, name });\nawait client.auth.signOut();\nconst session = await client.auth.getSession();\n\n// Social sign-in\nawait client.auth.signIn.social({\n  provider: 'google', // or 'github'\n  callbackURL: '/dashboard',\n});\n```\n\n## BetterAuthReactAdapter\n\nProvides React hooks for state management. **Must import from subpath.**\n\n```typescript\nimport { createClient } from \"@neondatabase/neon-js\";\n// NOT exported from main entry - must use subpath\nimport { BetterAuthReactAdapter } from \"@neondatabase/neon-js/auth/react/adapters\";\n\nconst client = createClient({\n  auth: {\n    adapter: BetterAuthReactAdapter(), // Must call as function\n    url: import.meta.env.VITE_NEON_AUTH_URL,\n  },\n  dataApi: { url: import.meta.env.VITE_NEON_DATA_API_URL },\n});\n\n// React hook available\nfunction App() {\n  const session = client.auth.useSession();\n\n  if (session.isPending) return <div>Loading...<\/div>;\n  if (!session.data) return <LoginForm />;\n\n  return <Dashboard user={session.data.user} />;\n}\n\n// Auth methods (same as vanilla)\nawait client.auth.signIn.email({ email, password });\nawait client.auth.signUp.email({ email, password, name });\nawait client.auth.signOut();\n```\n\n## SupabaseAuthAdapter\n\nProvides Supabase-compatible API for easier migration. Exported from main entry.\n\n```typescript\nimport { createClient, SupabaseAuthAdapter } from \"@neondatabase/neon-js\";\n\nconst client = createClient({\n  auth: {\n    adapter: SupabaseAuthAdapter(), // Must call as function\n    url: process.env.NEON_AUTH_URL!,\n  },\n  dataApi: { url: process.env.NEON_DATA_API_URL! },\n});\n\n// Supabase-compatible methods\nawait client.auth.signInWithPassword({ email, password });\nawait client.auth.signUp({ email, password });\nconst { data: { session } } = await client.auth.getSession();\n\n// Auth state change listener\nclient.auth.onAuthStateChange((event, session) => {\n  console.log('Auth event:', event);\n  console.log('Session:', session);\n});\n\n// Social sign-in (Supabase style)\nawait client.auth.signInWithOAuth({\n  provider: 'google',\n  options: { redirectTo: '/dashboard' },\n});\n```\n\n## Adapter Comparison\n\n| Feature | BetterAuthVanilla | BetterAuthReact | SupabaseAuth |\n|---------|-------------------|-----------------|--------------|\n| React hooks | No | Yes | No |\n| Sign in method | `signIn.email()` | `signIn.email()` | `signInWithPassword()` |\n| Get session | `getSession()` | `getSession()` / `useSession()` | `getSession()` |\n| State listener | No | React state | `onAuthStateChange()` |\n| Bundle size | Smallest | Medium | Medium |\n| Best for | Node.js, SSR | React SPAs | Supabase migration |\n\n## Supabase Migration Guide\n\n### Step 1: Update imports\n\n```diff\n- import { createClient } from \"@supabase/supabase-js\";\n+ import { createClient, SupabaseAuthAdapter } from \"@neondatabase/neon-js\";\n```\n\n### Step 2: Update client creation\n\n```diff\n- const client = createClient(SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_KEY);\n+ const client = createClient({\n+   auth: { adapter: SupabaseAuthAdapter(), url: NEON_AUTH_URL },\n+   dataApi: { url: NEON_DATA_API_URL },\n+ });\n```\n\n### Step 3: Auth methods work the same\n\n```typescript\n// These work identically\nawait client.auth.signInWithPassword({ email, password });\nawait client.auth.signUp({ email, password });\nconst { data: { session } } = await client.auth.getSession();\nclient.auth.onAuthStateChange((event, session) => { /* ... */ });\n```\n\n### Step 4: Database queries work the same\n\n```typescript\n// PostgREST syntax is identical\nconst { data } = await client.from(\"items\").select(\"*\");\nawait client.from(\"items\").insert({ name: \"Item\" });\nawait client.from(\"items\").update({ status: \"done\" }).eq(\"id\", 1);\nawait client.from(\"items\").delete().eq(\"id\", 1);\n```\n\n## Common Adapter Mistakes\n\n### 1. Forgetting to call adapter as function\n\n```typescript\n// Wrong\nauth: { adapter: SupabaseAuthAdapter, url }\n\n// Correct\nauth: { adapter: SupabaseAuthAdapter(), url }\n```\n\n### 2. Importing BetterAuthReactAdapter from main entry\n\n```typescript\n// Wrong - not exported from main\nimport { BetterAuthReactAdapter } from \"@neondatabase/neon-js\";\n\n// Correct\nimport { BetterAuthReactAdapter } from \"@neondatabase/neon-js/auth/react/adapters\";\n```\n\n### 3. Using wrong API for adapter\n\n```typescript\n// Wrong - BetterAuth API with SupabaseAuthAdapter\nclient.auth.signIn.email({ email, password }); // Won't work\n\n// Correct - Supabase API with SupabaseAuthAdapter\nclient.auth.signInWithPassword({ email, password });\n```\n\n## Auth Only Package\n\nIf you don't need database queries, use `@neondatabase/auth` for a smaller bundle:\n\n```typescript\n// Install: npm install @neondatabase/auth\nimport { createAuthClient } from \"@neondatabase/auth\";\nimport { BetterAuthReactAdapter } from \"@neondatabase/auth/react/adapters\";\n\n// First arg is URL, second is config\nconst auth = createAuthClient(import.meta.env.VITE_NEON_AUTH_URL, {\n  adapter: BetterAuthReactAdapter(),\n});\n\n// React hook\nconst session = auth.useSession();\n\n// Auth methods\nawait auth.signIn.email({ email, password });\nawait auth.signUp.email({ email, password, name });\nawait auth.signOut();\n```\n",
      "renderedContent": "<h1>Neon JS SDK - Auth Adapters<\/h1>\n<p>Three adapters available for different API styles. <strong>All adapters are factory functions that must be called with <code>()<\/code>.<\/strong><\/p>\n<h2>BetterAuthVanillaAdapter (Default)<\/h2>\n<p>Used automatically when no adapter is specified. Best for Node.js backends and non-React environments.<\/p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-typescript\">import { createClient } from &quot;@neondatabase/neon-js&quot;;\n\n// Default adapter - no need to specify\nconst client = createClient({\n  auth: { url: process.env.NEON_AUTH_URL! },\n  dataApi: { url: process.env.NEON_DATA_API_URL! },\n});\n\n// Auth methods\nawait client.auth.signIn.email({ email, password });\nawait client.auth.signUp.email({ email, password, name });\nawait client.auth.signOut();\nconst session = await client.auth.getSession();\n\n// Social sign-in\nawait client.auth.signIn.social({\n  provider: &#39;google&#39;, // or &#39;github&#39;\n  callbackURL: &#39;/dashboard&#39;,\n});\n<\/code><\/pre>\n<h2>BetterAuthReactAdapter<\/h2>\n<p>Provides React hooks for state management. <strong>Must import from subpath.<\/strong><\/p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-typescript\">import { createClient } from &quot;@neondatabase/neon-js&quot;;\n// NOT exported from main entry - must use subpath\nimport { BetterAuthReactAdapter } from &quot;@neondatabase/neon-js/auth/react/adapters&quot;;\n\nconst client = createClient({\n  auth: {\n    adapter: BetterAuthReactAdapter(), // Must call as function\n    url: import.meta.env.VITE_NEON_AUTH_URL,\n  },\n  dataApi: { url: import.meta.env.VITE_NEON_DATA_API_URL },\n});\n\n// React hook available\nfunction App() {\n  const session = client.auth.useSession();\n\n  if (session.isPending) return &lt;div&gt;Loading...&lt;/div&gt;;\n  if (!session.data) return &lt;LoginForm /&gt;;\n\n  return &lt;Dashboard user={session.data.user} /&gt;;\n}\n\n// Auth methods (same as vanilla)\nawait client.auth.signIn.email({ email, password });\nawait client.auth.signUp.email({ email, password, name });\nawait client.auth.signOut();\n<\/code><\/pre>\n<h2>SupabaseAuthAdapter<\/h2>\n<p>Provides Supabase-compatible API for easier migration. Exported from main entry.<\/p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-typescript\">import { createClient, SupabaseAuthAdapter } from &quot;@neondatabase/neon-js&quot;;\n\nconst client = createClient({\n  auth: {\n    adapter: SupabaseAuthAdapter(), // Must call as function\n    url: process.env.NEON_AUTH_URL!,\n  },\n  dataApi: { url: process.env.NEON_DATA_API_URL! },\n});\n\n// Supabase-compatible methods\nawait client.auth.signInWithPassword({ email, password });\nawait client.auth.signUp({ email, password });\nconst { data: { session } } = await client.auth.getSession();\n\n// Auth state change listener\nclient.auth.onAuthStateChange((event, session) =&gt; {\n  console.log(&#39;Auth event:&#39;, event);\n  console.log(&#39;Session:&#39;, session);\n});\n\n// Social sign-in (Supabase style)\nawait client.auth.signInWithOAuth({\n  provider: &#39;google&#39;,\n  options: { redirectTo: &#39;/dashboard&#39; },\n});\n<\/code><\/pre>\n<h2>Adapter Comparison<\/h2>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Feature<\/th>\n<th>BetterAuthVanilla<\/th>\n<th>BetterAuthReact<\/th>\n<th>SupabaseAuth<\/th>\n<\/tr>\n<\/thead>\n<tbody><tr>\n<td>React hooks<\/td>\n<td>No<\/td>\n<td>Yes<\/td>\n<td>No<\/td>\n<\/tr>\n<tr>\n<td>Sign in method<\/td>\n<td><code>signIn.email()<\/code><\/td>\n<td><code>signIn.email()<\/code><\/td>\n<td><code>signInWithPassword()<\/code><\/td>\n<\/tr>\n<tr>\n<td>Get session<\/td>\n<td><code>getSession()<\/code><\/td>\n<td><code>getSession()<\/code> / <code>useSession()<\/code><\/td>\n<td><code>getSession()<\/code><\/td>\n<\/tr>\n<tr>\n<td>State listener<\/td>\n<td>No<\/td>\n<td>React state<\/td>\n<td><code>onAuthStateChange()<\/code><\/td>\n<\/tr>\n<tr>\n<td>Bundle size<\/td>\n<td>Smallest<\/td>\n<td>Medium<\/td>\n<td>Medium<\/td>\n<\/tr>\n<tr>\n<td>Best for<\/td>\n<td>Node.js, SSR<\/td>\n<td>React SPAs<\/td>\n<td>Supabase migration<\/td>\n<\/tr>\n<\/tbody><\/table>\n<h2>Supabase Migration Guide<\/h2>\n<h3>Step 1: Update imports<\/h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-diff\">- import { createClient } from &quot;@supabase/supabase-js&quot;;\n+ import { createClient, SupabaseAuthAdapter } from &quot;@neondatabase/neon-js&quot;;\n<\/code><\/pre>\n<h3>Step 2: Update client creation<\/h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-diff\">- const client = createClient(SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_KEY);\n+ const client = createClient({\n+   auth: { adapter: SupabaseAuthAdapter(), url: NEON_AUTH_URL },\n+   dataApi: { url: NEON_DATA_API_URL },\n+ });\n<\/code><\/pre>\n<h3>Step 3: Auth methods work the same<\/h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-typescript\">// These work identically\nawait client.auth.signInWithPassword({ email, password });\nawait client.auth.signUp({ email, password });\nconst { data: { session } } = await client.auth.getSession();\nclient.auth.onAuthStateChange((event, session) =&gt;       "contentPreview": "Complete reference for PostgREST-style database queries using .\nClient Setup\nQuery Patterns\n  - Select Queries\n  - Insert\n  - Update\n  - Delete\n  - Upsert\nFiltering\nRelationships\nType Generation\nError Handling\nSupabase Migration\n---\n**Environment Variables:**\n---\nAll query methods follow PostgREST s",
      "rawContent": "# Neon JS Data API Reference\n\nComplete reference for PostgREST-style database queries using `@neondatabase/neon-js`.\n\n## Table of Contents\n\n- [Client Setup](#client-setup)\n- [Query Patterns](#query-patterns)\n  - [Select Queries](#select-queries)\n  - [Insert](#insert)\n  - [Update](#update)\n  - [Delete](#delete)\n  - [Upsert](#upsert)\n- [Filtering](#filtering)\n- [Relationships](#relationships)\n- [Type Generation](#type-generation)\n- [Error Handling](#error-handling)\n- [Supabase Migration](#supabase-migration)\n\n---\n\n## Client Setup\n\n### Next.js\n\n```typescript\n// lib/db/client.ts\nimport { createClient } from \"@neondatabase/neon-js\";\nimport type { Database } from \"./database.types\";\n\nexport const dbClient = createClient<Database>({\n  auth: { url: process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_NEON_AUTH_URL! },\n  dataApi: { url: process.env.NEON_DATA_API_URL! },\n});\n```\n\n**Environment Variables:**\n```bash\n# .env.local\nNEON_DATA_API_URL=https://ep-xxx.apirest.c-2.us-east-2.aws.neon.build/dbname/rest/v1\n```\n\n### React SPA\n\n```typescript\nimport { createClient } from \"@neondatabase/neon-js\";\nimport { BetterAuthReactAdapter } from \"@neondatabase/neon-js/auth/react/adapters\";\n\nconst client = createClient<Database>({\n  auth: {\n    adapter: BetterAuthReactAdapter(),\n    url: import.meta.env.VITE_NEON_AUTH_URL,\n  },\n  dataApi: { url: import.meta.env.VITE_NEON_DATA_API_URL },\n});\n```\n\n### Node.js Backend\n\n```typescript\nimport { createClient } from \"@neondatabase/neon-js\";\n\nconst client = createClient<Database>({\n  auth: { url: process.env.NEON_AUTH_URL! },\n  dataApi: { url: process.env.NEON_DATA_API_URL! },\n});\n```\n\n---\n\n## Query Patterns\n\nAll query methods follow PostgREST syntax (same as Supabase).\n\n### Select Queries\n\n**Basic select:**\n```typescript\nconst { data, error } = await client.from(\"items\").select();\n```\n\n**Select specific columns:**\n```typescript\nconst { data } = await client.from(\"items\")\n  .select(\"id, name, status\");\n```\n\n**Select with filters:**\n```typescript\nconst { data } = await client.from(\"items\")\n  .select(\"id, name, status\")\n  .eq(\"status\", \"active\")\n  .order(\"created_at\", { ascending: false })\n  .limit(10);\n```\n\n**Select single row:**\n```typescript\nconst { data, error } = await client.from(\"items\")\n  .select(\"*\")\n  .eq(\"id\", 1)\n  .single();\n```\n\n### Insert\n\n**Insert single row:**\n```typescript\nconst { data, error } = await client.from(\"items\")\n  .insert({ name: \"New Item\", status: \"pending\" })\n  .select()\n  .single();\n```\n\n**Insert multiple rows:**\n```typescript\nconst { data, error } = await client.from(\"items\")\n  .insert([\n    { name: \"Item 1\", status: \"pending\" },\n    { name: \"Item 2\", status: \"pending\" }\n  ])\n  .select();\n```\n\n**Insert without returning data:**\n```typescript\nawait client.from(\"items\")\n  .insert({ name: \"New Item\", status: \"pending\" });\n```\n\n### Update\n\n**Update with filter:**\n```typescript\nawait client.from(\"items\")\n  .update({ status: \"completed\" })\n  .eq(\"id\", 1);\n```\n\n**Update multiple rows:**\n```typescript\nawait client.from(\"items\")\n  .update({ status: \"archived\" })\n  .eq(\"status\", \"completed\");\n```\n\n**Update and return data:**\n```typescript\nconst { data, error } = await client.from(\"items\")\n  .update({ status: \"completed\" })\n  .eq(\"id\", 1)\n  .select()\n  .single();\n```\n\n### Delete\n\n**Delete single row:**\n```typescript\nawait client.from(\"items\")\n  .delete()\n  .eq(\"id\", 1);\n```\n\n**Delete multiple rows:**\n```typescript\nawait client.from(\"items\")\n  .delete()\n  .eq(\"status\", \"archived\");\n```\n\n**Delete and return data:**\n```typescript\nconst { data, error } = await client.from(\"items\")\n  .delete()\n  .eq(\"id\", 1)\n  .select()\n  .single();\n```\n\n### Upsert\n\n**Upsert (insert or update):**\n```typescript\nawait client.from(\"items\")\n  .upsert({ id: 1, name: \"Updated Item\", status: \"active\" });\n```\n\n**Upsert with conflict resolution:**\n```typescript\nawait client.from(\"items\")\n  .upsert(\n    { id: 1, name: \"Updated Item\" },\n    { onConflict: \"id\" }\n  );\n```\n\n---\n\n## Filtering\n\n### Comparison Operators\n\n```typescript\n// Equal\n.eq(\"status\", \"active\")\n\n// Not equal\n.neq(\"status\", \"archived\")\n\n// Greater than\n.gt(\"price\", 100)\n\n// Greater than or equal\n.gte(\"price\", 100)\n\n// Less than\n.lt(\"price\", 100)\n\n// Less than or equal\n.lte(\"price\", 100)\n\n// Like (pattern matching)\n.like(\"name\", \"%item%\")\n\n// ILike (case-insensitive)\n.ilike(\"name\", \"%item%\")\n\n// Is null\n.is(\"deleted_at\", null)\n\n// Is not null\n.not(\"deleted_at\", \"is\", null)\n\n// In array\n.in(\"status\", [\"active\", \"pending\"])\n\n// Contains (for arrays/JSONB)\n.contains(\"tags\", [\"important\"])\n```\n\n### Logical Operators\n\n```typescript\n// AND (chained)\n.eq(\"status\", \"active\")\n.gt(\"price\", 100)\n\n// OR\n.or(\"status.eq.active,price.gt.100\")\n\n// NOT\n.not(\"status\", \"eq\", \"archived\")\n```\n\n### Ordering\n\n```typescript\n// Ascending\n.order(\"created_at\", { ascending: true })\n\n// Descending\n.order(\"created_at\", { ascending: false })\n\n// Multiple columns\n.order(\"status\", { ascending: true })\n.order(\"created_at\", { ascending: false })\n```\n\n### Pagination\n\n```typescript\n// Limit\n.limit(10)\n\n// Range (offset + limit)\n.range(0, 9)  // First 10 items\n\n// Range for pagination\nconst page = 1;\nconst pageSize = 10;\n.range((page - 1) * pageSize, page * pageSize - 1)\n```\n\n---\n\n## Relationships\n\n### Select with Relationships\n\n**One-to-many:**\n```typescript\nconst { data } = await client.from(\"posts\")\n  .select(\"id, title, author:users(name, email)\");\n```\n\n**Many-to-many:**\n```typescript\nconst { data } = await client.from(\"posts\")\n  .select(\"id, title, tags:post_tags(tag:tags(name))\");\n```\n\n**Nested relationships:**\n```typescript\nconst { data } = await client.from(\"posts\")\n  .select(`\n    id,\n    title,\n    author:users(\n      id,\n      name,\n      profile:profiles(bio, avatar)\n    )\n  `);\n```\n\n### Foreign Key Relationships\n\nThe Data API automatically resolves foreign key relationships based on your database schema. Use the `:` syntax to specify the relationship:\n\n```typescript\n// If posts.user_id references users.id\n.select(\"id, title, user:users(name, email)\")\n\n// If posts.author_id references users.id\n.select(\"id, title, author:users(name, email)\")\n```\n\n---\n\n## Type Generation\n\nGenerate TypeScript types from your database schema:\n\n```bash\nnpx neon-js gen-types --db-url \"postgresql://user:pass@host/db\" --output src/types/database.ts\n```\n\nOr using environment variable:\n\n```bash\nnpx neon-js gen-types --db-url \"$DATABASE_URL\" --output lib/db/database.types.ts\n```\n\n**Use types in client:**\n\n```typescript\nimport { createClient } from \"@neondatabase/neon-js\";\nimport type { Database } from \"./database.types\";\n\nexport const dbClient = createClient<Database>({\n  auth: { url: process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_NEON_AUTH_URL! },\n  dataApi: { url: process.env.NEON_DATA_API_URL! },\n});\n```\n\n**Benefits:**\n- Full TypeScript autocomplete for tables and columns\n- Type-safe queries\n- Compile-time error checking\n\n---\n\n## Error Handling\n\n**Check for errors:**\n```typescript\nconst { data, error } = await client.from(\"items\").select();\n\nif (error) {\n  console.error(\"Database error:\", error.message);\n  console.error(\"Error code:\", error.code);\n  console.error(\"Error details:\", error.details);\n  return;\n}\n\n// Use data\nconsole.log(data);\n```\n\n**Common error codes:**\n- `PGRST116` - No rows returned (when using `.single()`)\n- `23505` - Unique violation\n- `23503` - Foreign key violation\n- `42P01` - Table does not exist\n\n**Error handling pattern:**\n```typescript\ntry {\n  const { data, error } = await client.from(\"items\")\n    .insert({ name: \"New Item\" })\n    .select()\n    .single();\n\n  if (error) throw error;\n  \n  return { success: true, data };\n} catch (error) {\n  console.error(\"Failed to insert item:\", error);\n  return { success: false, error };\n}\n```\n\n---\n\n## Supabase Migration\n\nThe Neon JS SDK uses the same PostgREST API as Supabase, making migration straightforward:\n\n**Before (Supabase):**\n```typescript\nimport { createClient } from \"@supabase/supabase-js\";\n\nconst client = createClient(SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_KEY);\n```\n\n**After (Neon):**\n```typescript\nimport { createClient, SupabaseAuthAdapter } from \"@neondatabase/neon-js\";\n\nconst client = createClient({\n  auth: { adapter: SupabaseAuthAdapter(), url: NEON_AUTH_URL },\n  dataApi: { url: NEON_DATA_API_URL },\n});\n```\n\n**Query syntax remains the same:**\n```typescript\n// Works identically in both\nawait client.auth.signInWithPassword({ email, password });\nconst { data } = await client.from(\"items\").select();\n```\n\n**For BetterAuth API (default):**\n```typescript\nimport { createClient } from \"@neondatabase/neon-js\";\n\nconst client = createClient({\n  auth: { url: NEON_AUTH_URL },\n  dataApi: { url: NEON_DATA_API_URL },\n});\n\n// Use BetterAuth methods\nawait client.auth.signIn.email({ email, password });\nconst { data } = await client.from(\"items\").select();\n```\n\n---\n\n## Usage Examples\n\n### Server Component (Next.js)\n\n```typescript\n// app/posts/page.tsx\nimport { dbClient } from \"@/lib/db/client\";\n\nexport default async function PostsPage() {\n  const { data: posts, error } = await dbClient\n    .from(\"posts\")\n    .select(\"id, title, created_at, author:users(name)\")\n    .order(\"created_at\", { ascending: false })\n    .limit(10);\n\n  if (error) return <div>Error loading posts<\/div>;\n\n  return (\n    <ul>\n      {posts?.map((post) => (\n        <li key={post.id}>\n          <h2>{post.title}<\/h2>\n          <p>By {post.author?.name}<\/p>\n        <\/li>\n      ))}\n    <\/ul>\n  );\n}\n```\n\n### API Route (Next.js)\n\n```typescript\n// app/api/posts/route.ts\nimport { dbClient } from \"@/lib/db/client\";\nimport { NextResponse } from \"next/server\";\n\nexport async function GET() {\n  const { data, error } = await dbClient.from(\"posts\").select();\n\n  if (error) {\n    return NextResponse.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 500 });\n  }\n\n  return NextResponse.json(data);\n}\n\nexport async function POST(request: Request) {\n  const body = await request.json();\n\n  const { data, error } = await dbClient\n    .from(\"posts\")\n    .insert(body)\n    .select()\n    .single();\n\n  if (error) {\n    return NextResponse.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 400 });\n  }\n\n  return NextResponse.json(data, { status: 201 });\n}\n```\n\n### Client Component (React)\n\n```typescript\n\"use client\";\n\nimport { useEffect, useState } from \"react\";\nimport { dbClient } from \"@/lib/db/client\";\n\nexport function ItemsList() {\n  const [items, setItems] = useState([]);\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    async function fetchItems() {\n      const { data, error } = await dbClient\n        .from(\"items\")\n        .select(\"id, name, status\")\n        .eq(\"status\", \"active\");\n\n      if (error) {\n        console.error(error);\n        return;\n      }\n\n      setItems(data || []);\n      setLoading(false);\n    }\n\n    fetchItems();\n  }, []);\n\n  if (loading) return <div>Loading...<\/div>;\n\n  return (\n    <ul>\n      {items.map((item) => (\n        <li key={item.id}>{item.name}<\/li>\n      ))}\n    <\/ul>\n  );\n}\n```\n\n---\n\n## Related References\n\n- [Setup Reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/neondatabase-labs/ai-rules/main/references/neon-auth-setup.md) - Complete auth setup guide\n- [Import Reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/neondatabase-labs/ai-rules/main/references/neon-js-imports.md) - Complete import paths\n- [Common Mistakes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/neondatabase-labs/ai-rules/main/references/neon-auth-common-mistakes.md) - Import paths, adapter patterns\n\n---\n\n**Reference Version**: 1.0.0  \n**Last Updated**: 2025-12-09\n",

Relationships<\/h3>\n<p>The Data API automatically resolves foreign key relationships based on your database schema. Use the <code>:<\/code> syntax to specify the relationship:<\/p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-typescript\">// If posts.user_id references users.id\n.select(&quot;id, title, user:users(name, email)&quot;)\n\n// If posts.author_id references users.id\n.select(&quot;id, title, author:users(name, email)&quot;)\n<\/code><\/pre>\n<hr>\n<h2>Type Generation<\/h2>\n<p>Generate TypeScript types from your database schema:<\/p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-bash\">npx neon-js gen-types --db-url &quot;postgresql://user:pass@host/db&quot; --output src/types/database.ts\n<\/code><\/pre>\n<p>Or using environment variable:<\/p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-bash\">npx neon-js gen-types --db-url &quot;$DATABASE_URL&quot; --output lib/db/database.types.ts\n<\/code><\/pre>\n<p><strong>Use types in client:<\/strong><\/p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-typescript\">import { createClient } from &quot;@neondatabase/neon-js&quot;;\nimport type { Database } from &quot;./database.types&quot;;\n\nexport const dbClient = createClient&lt;Database&gt;({\n  auth: { url: process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_NEON_AUTH_URL! },\n  dataApi: { url: process.env.NEON_DATA_API_URL! },\n});\n<\/code><\/pre>\n<p><strong>Benefits:<\/strong><\/p>\n<ul>\n<li>Full TypeScript autocomplete for tables and columns<\/li>\n<li>Type-safe queries<\/li>\n<li>Compile-time error checking<\/li>\n<\/ul>\n<hr>\n<h2>Error Handling<\/h2>\n<p><strong>Check for errors:<\/strong><\/p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-typescript\">const { data, error } = await client.from(&quot;items&quot;).select();\n\nif (error) {\n  console.error(&quot;Database error:&quot;, error.message);\n  console.error(&quot;Error code:&quot;, error.code);\n  console.error(&quot;Error details:&quot;, error.details);\n  return;\n}\n\n// Use data\nconsole.log(data);\n<\/code><\/pre>\n<p><strong>Common error codes:<\/strong><\/p>\n<ul>\n<li><code>PGRST116<\/code> - No rows returned (when using <code>.single()<\/code>)<\/li>\n<li><code>23505<\/code> - Unique violation<\/li>\n<li><code>23503<\/code> - Foreign key violation<\/li>\n<li><code>42P01<\/code> - Table does not exist<\/li>\n<\/ul>\n<p><strong>Error handling pattern:<\/strong><\/p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-typescript\">try {\n  const { data, error } = await client.from(&quot;items&quot;)\n    .insert({ name: &quot;New Item&quot; })\n    .select()\n    .single();\n\n  if (error) throw error;\n  \n  return { success: true, data };\n} catch (error) {\n  console.error(&quot;Failed to insert item:&quot;, error);\n  return { success: false, error };\n}\n<\/code><\/pre>\n<hr>\n<h2>Supabase Migration<\/h2>\n<p>The Neon JS SDK uses the same PostgREST API as Supabase, making migration straightforward:<\/p>\n<p><strong>Before (Supabase):<\/strong><\/p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-typescript\">import { createClient } from &quot;@supabase/supabase-js&quot;;\n\nconst client = createClient(SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_KEY);\n<\/code><\/pre>\n<p><strong>After (Neon):<\/strong><\/p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-typescript\">import { createClient, SupabaseAuthAdapter } from &quot;@neondatabase/neon-js&quot;;\n\nconst client = createClient({\n  auth: { adapter: SupabaseAuthAdapter(), url: NEON_AUTH_URL },\n  dataApi: { url: NEON_DATA_API_URL },\n});\n<\/code><\/pre>\n<p><strong>Query syntax remains the same:<\/strong><\/p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-typescript\">// Works identically in both\nawait client.auth.signInWithPassword({ email, password });\nconst { data } = await client.from(&quot;items&quot;).select();\n<\/code><\/pre>\n<p><strong>For BetterAuth API (default):<\/strong><\/p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-typescript\">import { createClient } from &quot;@neondatabase/neon-js&quot;;\n\nconst client = createClient({\n  auth: { url: NEON_AUTH_URL },\n  dataApi: { url: NEON_DATA_API_URL },\n});\n\n// Use BetterAuth methods\nawait client.auth.signIn.email({ email, password });\nconst { data } = await client.from(&quot;items&quot;).select();\n<\/code><\/pre>\n<hr>\n<h2>Usage Examples<\/h2>\n<h3>Server Component (Next.js)<\/h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-typescript\">// app/posts/page.tsx\nimport { dbClient } from &quot;@/lib/db/client&quot;;\n\nexport default async function PostsPage() {\n  const { data: posts, error } = await dbClient\n    .from(&quot;posts&quot;)\n    .select(&quot;id, title, created_at, author:users(name)&quot;)\n    .order(&quot;created_at&quot;, { ascending: false })\n    .limit(10);\n\n  if (error) return &lt;div&gt;Error loading posts&lt;/div&gt;;\n\n  return (\n    &lt;ul&gt;\n      {posts?.map((post) =&gt; (\n        &lt;li key={post.id}&gt;\n          &lt;h2&gt;{post.title}&lt;/h2&gt;\n          &lt;p&gt;By {post.author?.name}&lt;/p&gt;\n        &lt;/li&gt;\n      ))}\n    &lt;/ul&gt;\n  );\n}\n<\/code><\/pre>\n<h3>API Route (Next.js)<\/h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-typescript\">// app/api/posts/route.ts\nimport { dbClient } from &quot;@/lib/db/client&quot;;\nimport { NextResponse } from &quot;next/server&quot;;\n\nexport async function GET() {\n  const { data, error } = await dbClient.from(&quot;posts&quot;).select();\n\n  if (error) {\n    return NextResponse.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 500 });\n  }\n\n  return NextResponse.json(data);\n}\n\nexport async function POST(request: Request) {\n  const body = await request.json();\n\n  const { data, error } = await dbClient\n    .from(&quot;posts&quot;)\n    .insert(body)\n    .select()\n    .single();\n\n  if (error) {\n    return NextResponse.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 400 });\n  }\n\n  return NextResponse.json(data, { status: 201 });\n}\n<\/code><\/pre>\n<h3>Client Component (React)<\/h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-typescript\">&quot;use client&quot;;\n\nimport { useEffect, useState } from &quot;react&quot;;\nimport { dbClient } from &quot;@/lib/db/client&quot;;\n\nexport function ItemsList() {\n  const [items, setItems] = useState([]);\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);\n\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    async function fetchItems() {\n      const { data, error } = await dbClient\n        .from(&quot;items&quot;)\n        .select(&quot;id, name, status&quot;)\n        .eq(&quot;status&quot;, &quot;active&quot;);\n\n      if (error) {\n        console.error(error);\n        return;\n      }\n\n      setItems(data || []);\n      setLoading(false);\n    }\n\n    fetchItems();\n  }, []);\n\n  if (loading) return &lt;div&gt;Loading...&lt;/div&gt;;\n\n  return (\n    &lt;ul&gt;\n      {items.map((item) =&gt; (\n        &lt;li key={item.id}&gt;{item.name}&lt;/li&gt;\n      ))}\n    &lt;/ul&gt;\n  );\n}\n<\/code><\/pre>\n<hr>\n<h2>Related References<\/h2>\n<ul>\n<li><a href=\"https://raw.githubusercontent.com/neondatabase-labs/ai-rules/main/references/neon-auth-setup.md\">Setup Reference<\/a> - Complete auth setup guide<\/li>\n<li><a href=\"https://raw.githubusercontent.com/neondatabase-labs/ai-rules/main/references/neon-js-imports.md\">Import Reference<\/a> - Complete import paths<\/li>\n<li><a href=\"https://raw.githubusercontent.com/neondatabase-labs/ai-rules/main/references/neon-auth-common-mistakes.md\">Common Mistakes<\/a> - Import paths, adapter patterns<\/li>\n<\/ul>\n<hr>\n<p><strong>Reference Version<\/strong>: 1.0.0<br><strong>Last Updated<\/strong>: 2025-12-09<\/p>\n"

      "contentPreview": "Complete import paths for all  packages.\n**Never import both** - causes duplicate styles.\nSmaller bundle when you don't need database queries.\nUse when bringing your own authentication.\n| Export | Main Entry | Subpath Required |\n|--------|------------|------------------|\n|  | Yes | No |\n|  | Yes | N",
      "rawContent": "# Neon JS SDK - Import Reference\n\nComplete import paths for all `@neondatabase` packages.\n\n## @neondatabase/neon-js (Full SDK)\n\n### Main Entry\n\n```typescript\nimport {\n  createClient,\n  SupabaseAuthAdapter,\n  BetterAuthVanillaAdapter\n} from \"@neondatabase/neon-js\";\n```\n\n### Auth Subpaths\n\n```typescript\n// Next.js integration\nimport { authApiHandler, createAuthClient, neonAuth } from \"@neondatabase/neon-js/auth/next\";\n\n// React adapters (NOT from main entry)\nimport { BetterAuthReactAdapter } from \"@neondatabase/neon-js/auth/react/adapters\";\n\n// Vanilla adapters (also available from main entry)\nimport { BetterAuthVanillaAdapter, SupabaseAuthAdapter } from \"@neondatabase/neon-js/auth/vanilla/adapters\";\n```\n\n### UI Components\n\n```typescript\n// React UI components\nimport {\n  NeonAuthUIProvider,\n  AuthView,\n  SignInForm,\n  SignUpForm,\n  UserButton,\n  UserAvatar,\n  ForgotPasswordForm,\n  ResetPasswordForm,\n  MagicLinkForm,\n  TwoFactorForm,\n  SettingsCard\n} from \"@neondatabase/neon-js/auth/react/ui\";\n\n// Server utilities (for Next.js page generation)\nimport { authViewPaths } from \"@neondatabase/neon-js/auth/react/ui/server\";\n```\n\n### UI CSS\n\n```typescript\n// Without Tailwind - pre-built CSS bundle (~47KB)\nimport \"@neondatabase/neon-js/ui/css\";\n```\n\n```css\n/* With Tailwind v4 - token definitions only (~2KB) */\n@import 'tailwindcss';\n@import '@neondatabase/neon-js/ui/tailwind';\n```\n\n**Never import both** - causes duplicate styles.\n\n## @neondatabase/auth (Auth Only)\n\nSmaller bundle when you don't need database queries.\n\n### Main Entry\n\n```typescript\nimport { createAuthClient } from \"@neondatabase/auth\";\n```\n\n### Adapters\n\n```typescript\n// React adapter (NOT from main entry)\nimport { BetterAuthReactAdapter } from \"@neondatabase/auth/react/adapters\";\n\n// Vanilla adapters\nimport { BetterAuthVanillaAdapter, SupabaseAuthAdapter } from \"@neondatabase/auth/vanilla/adapters\";\n```\n\n### Next.js Integration\n\n```typescript\nimport { authApiHandler, createAuthClient, neonAuth } from \"@neondatabase/auth/next\";\n```\n\n### UI Components\n\n```typescript\nimport { NeonAuthUIProvider, AuthView, SignInForm } from \"@neondatabase/auth/react/ui\";\nimport { authViewPaths } from \"@neondatabase/auth/react/ui/server\";\n```\n\n### UI CSS\n\n```typescript\nimport \"@neondatabase/auth/ui/css\";\n```\n\n## @neondatabase/postgrest-js (Data Only)\n\nUse when bringing your own authentication.\n\n```typescript\nimport { NeonPostgrestClient, fetchWithToken } from \"@neondatabase/postgrest-js\";\n\nconst client = new NeonPostgrestClient({\n  dataApiUrl: process.env.NEON_DATA_API_URL!,\n  options: {\n    global: {\n      fetch: fetchWithToken(async () => getTokenFromYourAuthSystem()),\n    },\n  },\n});\n```\n\n## Import Rules Summary\n\n| Export | Main Entry | Subpath Required |\n|--------|------------|------------------|\n| `createClient` | Yes | No |\n| `SupabaseAuthAdapter` | Yes | No |\n| `BetterAuthVanillaAdapter` | Yes | No |\n| `BetterAuthReactAdapter` | **No** | `auth/react/adapters` |\n| `createAuthClient` (Next.js) | **No** | `auth/next` |\n| `authApiHandler` | **No** | `auth/next` |\n| `NeonAuthUIProvider` | **No** | `auth/react/ui` |\n| UI CSS | **No** | `ui/css` or `ui/tailwind` |\n\n## Common Import Mistakes\n\n### Wrong: BetterAuthReactAdapter from main\n\n```typescript\n// This will NOT work\nimport { BetterAuthReactAdapter } from \"@neondatabase/neon-js\";\n```\n\n### Correct: BetterAuthReactAdapter from subpath\n\n```typescript\n// This works\nimport { BetterAuthReactAdapter } from \"@neondatabase/neon-js/auth/react/adapters\";\n```\n\n### Wrong: Both CSS imports\n\n```css\n/* Causes ~94KB of duplicate styles */\n@import '@neondatabase/neon-js/ui/css';\n@import '@neondatabase/neon-js/ui/tailwind';\n```\n\n### Correct: One CSS import\n\n```css\n/* Without Tailwind */\n@import '@neondatabase/neon-js/ui/css';\n\n/* OR with Tailwind v4 */\n@import 'tailwindcss';\n@import '@neondatabase/neon-js/ui/tailwind';\n```\n",
